# GBM ECM Analysis

## RNAseq ECM Analysis

To look at the gene expression of ECM genes across primary and recurrent GBM in CGGA data sets. 

### Library

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(pheatmap)
library(biomaRt)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(readxl)
```
### Download and upload input data

Data downloaded from https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp

Data that are already downloaded are not downloaded again. Chunks are skipped using , eval = FALSE in chunk. 

#### Download mRNAseq_693 data

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Download expression data from STAR+RSEM (FPKM Value) 
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

# Download clinical meta data
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693_clinical&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

```

### Filtering data to only include samples that follow WHO 2021 classification. 


Removed Samples that are not classified as GBM.

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 metadata
cgga693_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 metadata
cgga325_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}

# Filter CGGA-693: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga693_meta_gbm <- cgga693_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm","aa","a")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")

# Filter CGGA-325: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga325_meta_gbm <- cgga325_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm","aa","a")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")
```


### Add filters to gene expression data

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 gene expression data
cgga693_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 gene expression data
cgga325_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

#### Filter expression data using filtered meta data

There is a problem using select() function, so the code below specifies to use dplyr 

```{r}
# cgga 693 filter
ids_693 <- intersect(colnames(cgga693_expr)[-1], cgga693_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga693_expr_filt <- cgga693_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_693))

cgga693_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga693_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_693) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_693, CGGA_ID))

# cgga 325 filter
ids_325 <- intersect(colnames(cgga325_expr)[-1], cgga325_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga325_expr_filt <- cgga325_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_325))

cgga325_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga325_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_325) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_325, CGGA_ID))
```

### Load non-glioma control to environment

```{r}
# Load the control expression data
control_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA_RNAseq_Control_20.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


### Merge all Genes and Data
```{r}
# ---- Harmonize control column name (as you already do later) ----
control_expr <- control_expr %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene_Name = gene_name)

# ---- Deduplicate genes within each cohort BEFORE merging ----
cgga693_all <- cgga693_expr_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

cgga325_all <- cgga325_expr_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

control_all <- control_expr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- Intersect to common genes across all three (still ALL genes) ----
common_genes_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  cgga693_all$Gene_Name,
  cgga325_all$Gene_Name,
  control_all$Gene_Name
))

cgga693_all_common <- cgga693_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

cgga325_all_common <- cgga325_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

control_all_common <- control_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

# ---- Ensure unique sample IDs across cohorts (add suffixes only if needed) ----
samp_693 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga693_all_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_325 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga325_all_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_ctl <- setdiff(colnames(control_all_common), "Gene_Name")

overlap_693_325 <- intersect(samp_693, samp_325)
overlap_693_ctl  <- intersect(samp_693, samp_ctl)
overlap_325_ctl  <- intersect(samp_325, samp_ctl)

if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga693_all_common)[match(samp_693, colnames(cgga693_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_693, "_693")
}
if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga325_all_common)[match(samp_325, colnames(cgga325_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_325, "_325")
}
if (length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(control_all_common)[match(samp_ctl, colnames(control_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_ctl, "_CTRL")
}

# ---- Merge ALL genes by Gene_Name ----
merged_expr_all <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) dplyr::inner_join(x, y, by = "Gene_Name"),
  list(cgga693_all_common, cgga325_all_common, control_all_common)
)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(merged_expr_all$Gene_Name))
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(colnames(merged_expr_all))) == 0)

```

##### Merge meta data

```{r}
# --- MERGE META DATA (with survival) ---


# 'merged_expr_all' already built above
merged_samples <- colnames(merged_expr_all)[-1]

# Base meta frames (Group/Cohort)
meta693 <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      tolower(Histology) == "rgbm" ~ "rGBM",
      tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "aa", "a") ~ "GBM",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cohort = "CGGA693"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group))



meta325 <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      tolower(Histology) == "rgbm" ~ "rGBM",
      tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "aa", "a") ~ "GBM",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cohort = "CGGA325"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group))



ctl_ids <- setdiff(colnames(control_all_common), "Gene_Name")
metaCTL <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  group  = "Control",
  cohort = "Control"
)

# Helper: append suffix ONLY if present in merged sample IDs
add_suffix_if_needed <- function(df, suffix) {
  needs_suffix <- any(grepl(paste0(suffix, "$"), merged_samples))
  if (needs_suffix) df$sample_id <- paste0(df$sample_id, suffix)
  df
}

meta693 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta693, "_693")
meta325 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta325, "_325")
metaCTL <- add_suffix_if_needed(metaCTL, "_CTRL")

# Combine base meta and keep only samples that exist in merged expression
sample_meta_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(meta693, meta325, metaCTL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% merged_samples) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add radio/chemo
meta693_extra <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id   = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_693")

meta325_extra <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id   = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_325")

metaCTL_extra <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  Radio_status = NA_integer_,
  Chemo_status = NA_integer_
) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_CTRL")

# ---- NEW: bring in survival (OS_days, OS_event) ----
surv693 <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    OS_days   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)),
    OS_event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Censor (alive=0; dead=1)`))
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_693")

surv325 <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    OS_days   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)),
    OS_event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Censor (alive=0; dead=1)`))
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_325")

survCTL <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  OS_days   = NA_real_,
  OS_event  = NA_real_
) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_CTRL")

# Merge everything into sample_meta_all
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::bind_rows(meta693_extra, meta325_extra, metaCTL_extra), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::bind_rows(surv693, surv325, survCTL), by = "sample_id")

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(setequal(sample_meta_all$sample_id, merged_samples))
message("Survival rows with data: ", sum(!is.na(sample_meta_all$OS_days)), 
        " | events present: ", sum(!is.na(sample_meta_all$OS_event)))

# (Optional) a convenience in years for plotting tables
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OS_years = ifelse(!is.na(OS_days), OS_days / 365.25, NA_real_))

```

### Normalization and QC

```{r}
# Wide genes x samples matrix
expr_mat_all <- merged_expr_all %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene_Name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Align meta row order to columns exactly
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(expr_mat_all), sample_id))
stopifnot(identical(sample_meta_all$sample_id, colnames(expr_mat_all)))

# Log2 transform for QC/visualization
expr_log2_all <- log2(expr_mat_all + 1)

# Long table for QC plots
expr_all_long <- expr_log2_all %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene_Name") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene_Name, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_expr") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group  = factor(group,  levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control", "CGGA693", "CGGA325"))
  )

# QC: per-sample distributions
ggplot(expr_all_long, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(~ cohort, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "ALL genes: per-sample log2(FPKM+1) distributions",
       x = "Sample", y = "log2 expression") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

```
#### Batch effect correction

```{r}
# Indices
idx_tumor   <- which(sample_meta_all$group != "Control")
idx_control <- which(sample_meta_all$group == "Control")

expr_tumor_all   <- expr_log2_all[, idx_tumor, drop = FALSE]
expr_control_all <- expr_log2_all[, idx_control, drop = FALSE]

tumor_meta <- sample_meta_all[idx_tumor, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM","rGBM")))

batch_tumor  <- factor(tumor_meta$cohort)
design_tumor <- model.matrix(~ group, data = tumor_meta)

expr_tumor_adj_all <- limma::removeBatchEffect(expr_tumor_all,
                                               batch = batch_tumor,
                                               design = design_tumor)

# Recombine (keep original sample order)
expr_adj_all <- expr_log2_all
expr_adj_all[, idx_tumor]   <- expr_tumor_adj_all
expr_adj_all[, idx_control] <- expr_control_all

# Quick PCA check before/after
keep_genes <- apply(expr_log2_all, 1, var) > 0
X_before <- t(expr_log2_all[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE])
X_after  <- t(expr_adj_all[keep_genes,  , drop = FALSE])

pca_before <- prcomp(X_before, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_after  <- prcomp(X_after,  center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

ve_b <- (pca_before$sdev^2) / sum(pca_before$sdev^2)
ve_a <- (pca_after$sdev^2)  / sum(pca_after$sdev^2)

df_b <- as.data.frame(pca_before$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = "Before (log2 FPKM)")

df_a <- as.data.frame(pca_after$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = "After (tumor-only adj)")

group_cols <- c(Control = "grey40", GBM = "#1f77b4", rGBM = "#d62728")

ggplot(df_b, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA BEFORE batch correction",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_b[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_b[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

ggplot(df_a, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA AFTER tumor-only batch correction",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_a[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_a[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

```

### DEG Analysis pre-Gene list

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHUNK 1: Sample setup for Control vs All GBM
# ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_all"), exists("sample_meta_all"))

# Keep only Control + tumor samples
meta_deg <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TumorStatus = ifelse(group == "Control", "Control", "GBM"),
    TumorStatus = factor(TumorStatus, levels = c("Control", "GBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort)
  )

# Expression matrix subset
X_deg <- expr_adj_all[, meta_deg$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

# Hard checks (these must pass)
stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(X_deg), meta_deg$sample_id),
  all(!is.na(meta_deg$TumorStatus)),
  all(!is.na(meta_deg$cohort))
)

# Sanity printouts
table(meta_deg$TumorStatus)
table(meta_deg$cohort, meta_deg$TumorStatus)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHUNK 2: Design matrix inspection
# ============================================================

# Build design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ TumorStatus + cohort, data = meta_deg)

# Inspect
colnames(design)
head(design)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHUNK 3: limma fit + DEG extraction
# ============================================================

library(limma)

# Fit model
fit <- lmFit(X_deg, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# Extract DEGs: GBM (GBM + rGBM) vs Control
de_control_vs_gbm_all <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef = "TumorStatusGBM",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene_Name") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val, P.Value)

# Quick sanity checks
head(de_control_vs_gbm_all, 10)

summary(de_control_vs_gbm_all$logFC)
table(de_control_vs_gbm_all$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

stopifnot(exists("de_control_vs_gbm_all"))

write.csv(
  de_control_vs_gbm_all,
  file = "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/Control_vs_GBM_limma.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


```

```{r}
# Volcano with explicit FDR + logFC cutoffs

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 1
top_n <- 10

vol_df <- de_control_vs_gbm_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    neglog10FDR = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & logFC >=  logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in GBM",
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & logFC <= -logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in Control",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

label_df <- vol_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Up in GBM") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)

genes_highlight <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

ctrl_gbm_volcano <- ggplot(vol_df, aes(logFC, neglog10FDR)) +
  # Base points
  geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  
  # Highlight collagen genes (larger)
  geom_point(
    data = subset(vol_df, Gene_Name %in% genes_highlight),
    aes(logFC, neglog10FDR, color = direction),
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dotted") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up in GBM" = "firebrick",
      "Up in Control" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Control vs All GBM (GBM + rGBM)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "FDR < ", fdr_cutoff,
      " | |logFC| ≥ ", logfc_cutoff
    ),
    x = "logFC (GBM / Control)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(ctrl_gbm_volcano)


# ============================================================
# Save volcano plot 
# ============================================================

out_dir <- "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Control vs All GBM volcano:
# top 5 genes labeled in each direction by logFC
# ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("de_control_vs_gbm_all"))

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 1
top_n_each   <- 10

# Prepare volcano data
vol_df_top5 <- de_control_vs_gbm_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Prevent infinite values if adjusted P-value equals zero
    neglog10FDR = -log10(
      pmax(adj.P.Val, .Machine$double.xmin)
    ),

    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & logFC >= logfc_cutoff  ~ "Up in All GBM",
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & logFC <= -logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in Control",
      TRUE                                             ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Select top five genes by logFC in each direction
label_df_top5 <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  # Five highest positive logFC genes
  vol_df_top5 %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      direction == "Up in All GBM"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(logFC)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_each),

  # Five most negative logFC genes
  vol_df_top5 %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      direction == "Up in Control"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(logFC) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_each)
)

# Print selected genes for reference
label_df_top5 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene_Name,
    logFC,
    adj.P.Val,
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    direction,
    dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Create volcano plot
ctrl_gbm_volcano_top5 <- ggplot(
  vol_df_top5,
  aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10FDR)
) +

  # Plot all genes
  geom_point(
    aes(color = direction),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.2
  ) +

  # Highlight labeled genes
  geom_point(
    data = label_df_top5,
    aes(color = direction),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 1
  ) +

  # Add gene labels
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df_top5,
    aes(label = Gene_Name),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123
  ) +

  # FDR threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  # logFC thresholds
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff),
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up in All GBM" = "firebrick",
      "Up in Control" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Control vs All GBM",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top 5 genes per direction ranked by logFC",
      " | FDR < ", fdr_cutoff,
      " | |logFC| ≥ ", logfc_cutoff
    ),
    x = "logFC (All GBM / Control)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 25,
      b = 10,
      l = 25
    )
  )

print(ctrl_gbm_volcano_top5)

# ============================================================
# Save labeled volcano plot
# ============================================================

out_dir <- "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Control_vs_All_GBM_Volcano_Top10_LogFC.pdf"
  ),
  plot = ctrl_gbm_volcano_top5,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(exists("gene_df"))

# Ensure factor levels are set
gene_df <- gene_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")))

# All pairwise comparisons we want
pair_list <- list(
  c("Control", "GBM"),
  c("Control", "rGBM"),
  c("GBM", "rGBM")
)

# Helper: run one t-test for a given gene + comparison
run_pairwise_test <- function(df, g1, g2) {
  x <- df$expr[df$group == g1]
  y <- df$expr[df$group == g2]
  out <- t.test(x, y)
  tibble::tibble(
    Comparison = paste0(g1, " vs ", g2),
    p_raw = out$p.value
  )
}

# Post-hoc tests per gene (BONFERRONI within gene)
posthoc_tbl_clean <- gene_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tests = purrr::map(data, \(df) {
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        purrr::map(pair_list, \(cmp) run_pairwise_test(df, cmp[1], cmp[2]))
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(p_bonf = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "bonferroni"))
    })
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-data) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tests) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_raw  = signif(p_raw, 3),
    p_bonf = signif(p_bonf, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene, Comparison)

posthoc_tbl_clean

```

```{r}
anova_tbl <- gene_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM"))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, ~ stats::aov(expr ~ group, data = .x)),
    aov_tab = purrr::map(fit, ~ summary(.x)[[1]])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Gene,
    df_group = purrr::map_int(aov_tab, ~ .x["group", "Df"]),
    df_resid = purrr::map_int(aov_tab, ~ .x["Residuals", "Df"]),
    F_value  = purrr::map_dbl(aov_tab, ~ unname(.x["group", "F value"])),
    anova_p  = purrr::map_dbl(aov_tab, ~ unname(.x["group", "Pr(>F)"]))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    F_value = signif(F_value, 3),
    anova_p = signif(anova_p, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene)

anova_tbl
```

```{r}
stopifnot(
  exists("gene_df"),
  exists("anova_tbl"),
  exists("posthoc_tbl_clean")
)

# ---- 1) Sample counts per group (per gene) ----
counts_tbl <- gene_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = n,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# ---- 2) Post-hoc table to wide format ----
posthoc_wide <- posthoc_tbl_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Comparison, p_bonf) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Comparison,
    values_from = p_bonf
  )

# ---- 3) Combine everything ----
summary_stats_tbl <- counts_tbl %>%
  dplyr::left_join(anova_tbl %>% dplyr::mutate(anova_p = signif(anova_p, 3)),
                   by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(posthoc_wide, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene)

summary_stats_tbl
```

##### rGBM vs GBM

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DEG: rGBM vs GBM
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("expr_adj_all"),
  exists("sample_meta_all")
)

# ---- Subset to GBM + rGBM only ----
meta_rg <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort)
  )

X_rg <- expr_adj_all[, meta_rg$sample_id, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(X_rg), meta_rg$sample_id))

# ---- Design matrix (adjust for cohort) ----
design_rg <- model.matrix(~ group + cohort, data = meta_rg)
stopifnot("grouprGBM" %in% colnames(design_rg))

# ---- limma ----
fit_rg <- limma::lmFit(X_rg, design_rg)
fit_rg <- limma::eBayes(fit_rg)

de_rgbm_vs_gbm <- limma::topTable(
  fit_rg,
  coef = "grouprGBM",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene_Name") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val, P.Value)

# Quick sanity
head(de_rgbm_vs_gbm)
table(de_rgbm_vs_gbm$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
summary(de_rgbm_vs_gbm$logFC)

stopifnot(exists("de_rgbm_vs_gbm"))

write.csv(
  de_rgbm_vs_gbm,
  file = "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/rGBM_vs_GBM_limma.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
# Volcano: rGBM vs GBM

stopifnot(exists("de_rgbm_vs_gbm"))

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 1

vol_rg <- de_rgbm_vs_gbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    neglog10FDR = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & logFC >=  logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in rGBM",
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & logFC <= -logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in GBM",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    point_size = ifelse(Gene_Name %in% c("COL1A1", "COL3A1"), 3.5, 1.2)
  )

rgbm_volcano <- ggplot(vol_rg, aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10FDR)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = direction, size = point_size),
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +   # important — uses the actual numeric sizes
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up in rGBM" = "firebrick",
      "Up in GBM" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "rGBM vs Primary GBM",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "FDR < ", fdr_cutoff,
      " | |logFC| ≥ ", logfc_cutoff
    ),
    x = "logFC (rGBM / GBM)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(rgbm_volcano)

write.csv(
  vol_rg,
  file = "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/rGBM_vs_GBM_volcano.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# rGBM vs GBM volcano:
# label top 10 genes in each direction by logFC
# ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("vol_rg"))

top_n_each <- 10

# Select top five genes increased in rGBM
top_up_rgbm <- vol_rg %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Up in rGBM") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(logFC)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_each)

# Select top five genes increased in primary GBM
top_up_gbm <- vol_rg %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Up in GBM") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(logFC) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_each)

# Combine genes to label
label_rg <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  top_up_rgbm,
  top_up_gbm
)

# Print selected genes for reference
label_rg %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene_Name,
    logFC,
    adj.P.Val,
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    direction,
    dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Create labeled volcano
rgbm_volcano_labeled <- ggplot(
  vol_rg,
  aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10FDR)
) +

  # All genes
  geom_point(
    aes(color = direction),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.2
  ) +

  # Continue highlighting COL1A1 and COL3A1
  geom_point(
    data = vol_rg %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% c("COL1A1", "COL3A1")),
    aes(color = direction),
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 1
  ) +

  # Highlight the genes receiving labels
  geom_point(
    data = label_rg,
    aes(color = direction),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 1
  ) +

  # Add gene labels
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_rg,
    aes(label = Gene_Name),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123
  ) +

  # FDR threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  # logFC thresholds
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff),
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up in rGBM" = "firebrick",
      "Up in GBM" = "steelblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "rGBM vs Primary GBM",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top 5 genes per direction ranked by logFC",
      " | FDR < ", fdr_cutoff,
      " | |logFC| ≥ ", logfc_cutoff
    ),
    x = "logFC (rGBM / GBM)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 25,
      b = 10,
      l = 25
    )
  )

print(rgbm_volcano_labeled)

# ============================================================
# Save labeled volcano
# ============================================================

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
```

```{r}
stopifnot(exists("de_rgbm_vs_gbm"))

# ---- Rank genes for GSEA ----
gene_ranks_rg <- de_rgbm_vs_gbm$logFC
names(gene_ranks_rg) <- de_rgbm_vs_gbm$Gene_Name

# Remove NAs and duplicates (important)
gene_ranks_rg <- gene_ranks_rg[!is.na(gene_ranks_rg)]
gene_ranks_rg <- gene_ranks_rg[!duplicated(names(gene_ranks_rg))]

# Sort decreasing (required for GSEA)
gene_ranks_rg <- sort(gene_ranks_rg, decreasing = TRUE)

# ---- Run GSEA (GO Biological Process) ----
gsea_rg_bp <- gseGO(
  geneList     = gene_ranks_rg,
  OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  ont          = "BP",
  minGSSize    = 15,
  maxGSSize    = 500,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  verbose      = FALSE
)

# Quick checks
head(gsea_rg_bp@result)
table(gsea_rg_bp@result$NES > 0)
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------
# Define immune-related keywords

immune_keywords_rg <- c(
  "immune",
  "immunity",
  "lymphocyte",
  "leukocyte",
  "T cell",
  "T-cell",
  "B cell",
  "B-cell",
  "natural killer",
  "antigen",
  "interferon",
  "cytokine",
  "chemokine",
  "macrophage",
  "monocyte",
  "neutrophil",
  "dendritic",
  "microglia",
  "myeloid",
  "granulocyte",
  "adaptive immune",
  "innate immune",
  "defense response",
  "inflammatory",
  "inflammation",
  "phagocytosis",
  "immunoglobulin",
  "complement",
  "major histocompatibility",
  "MHC",
  "interleukin",
  "toll-like receptor",
  "tumor necrosis factor",
  "response to virus",
  "viral response",
  "antimicrobial",
  "lipopolysaccharide",
  "bacterial",
  "mononuclear"
  
)

# Combine terms into one search pattern
immune_pattern_rg <- paste(
  immune_keywords_rg,
  collapse = "|"
)

#-------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare significant rGBM-enriched GSEA results
#-------------------------------------------------------

gsea_sig_pos_rg <- gsea_rg_bp@result %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(p.adjust),

    p.adjust < 0.05

#-------------------------------------------------------
# Remove immune-related terms from the DISPLAYED results
#-------------------------------------------------------

gsea_nonimmune_rg <- gsea_sig_pos_rg %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !grepl(
      immune_pattern_rg,
      Description,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(NES))

# Inspect the top remaining terms

  dplyr::select(
    ID,
    Description,
    NES,
    pvalue,
    p.adjust
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 30)
```

#### Collagen score high vs low only in rGBM

```{r}
# Create CollagenScore + CollagenGroup (ALL tumors: GBM + rGBM)


stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_all"), exists("sample_meta_all"))

genes_collagen <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1") 

# Remove old columns if they exist (safe even after restart)
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("CollagenScore", "CollagenGroup")))

# Check genes exist in expression matrix
genes_present <- intersect(toupper(genes_collagen), toupper(rownames(expr_adj_all)))
if (length(genes_present) < 2) {
  stop("Too few collagen genes found in expr_adj_all rownames. Found: ",
       paste(genes_present, collapse = ", "))
}

idx <- match(genes_present, toupper(rownames(expr_adj_all)))
genes_use <- rownames(expr_adj_all)[idx]

# Compute score per sample
collagen_score <- colMeans(expr_adj_all[genes_use, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

collagen_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = names(collagen_score),
  CollagenScore = as.numeric(collagen_score)
)

# Join
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(collagen_tbl, by = "sample_id")

stopifnot("CollagenScore" %in% colnames(sample_meta_all))
stopifnot(!all(is.na(sample_meta_all$CollagenScore)))

# Median split using ALL tumors
cut_vec <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM")) %>%
  dplyr::pull(CollagenScore)

cutpoint <- median(cut_vec, na.rm = TRUE)

sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CollagenGroup = dplyr::case_when(
      group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM") & CollagenScore >= cutpoint ~ "CollagenHigh",
      group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM") & CollagenScore <  cutpoint ~ "CollagenLow",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    CollagenGroup = factor(CollagenGroup, levels = c("CollagenLow", "CollagenHigh"))
  )

# Sanity
summary(sample_meta_all$CollagenScore)
table(sample_meta_all$CollagenGroup, useNA = "ifany")
table(sample_meta_all$group, sample_meta_all$CollagenGroup, useNA = "ifany")

```

```{r}
# 1. Prepare volcano data
# ============================================================

vol_col <- de_col_high_vs_low %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    neglog10FDR = -log10(
      adj.P.Val
    ),

    direction = dplyr::case_when(

      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff &
        logFC >= logfc_cutoff ~
        "Up in CollagenHigh",

      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff &
        logFC <= -logfc_cutoff ~
        "Up in CollagenLow",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. Create volcano plot
# ============================================================

col_volcano <- ggplot(
  vol_col,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = neglog10FDR
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = direction
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.2
  ) +

  # FDR significance threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(
      fdr_cutoff
    ),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  # logFC thresholds
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      -logfc_cutoff,
      logfc_cutoff
    ),
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up in CollagenHigh" = "firebrick",
      "Up in CollagenLow"  = "steelblue",
      "Not significant"    = "grey70"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "CollagenHigh vs CollagenLow (All tumors)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "FDR < ",
      fdr_cutoff,
      " | |logFC| \u2265 ",
      logfc_cutoff
    ),
    x = "logFC (High / Low)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = ""
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )


print(
  col_volcano
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Save volcano plot and underlying data
# ============================================================

out_dir <- "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "CollagenHigh_vs_CollagenLow_ALLtumors_Volcano.pdf"
  ),
  plot = col_volcano,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)


write.csv(
  vol_col,
  file = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "CollagenHigh_vs_CollagenLow_ALLtumors_volcano.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# GSEA: CollagenHigh vs CollagenLow (ALL tumors) — GO BP

# ---- Build ranked gene list (robust duplicate handling) ----
rank_tbl_col <- de_col_high_vs_low %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Gene_Name = toupper(as.character(Gene_Name)),
    logFC     = as.numeric(logFC)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene_Name), Gene_Name != "", !is.na(logFC)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene_Name) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = abs(logFC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

gene_ranks_col <- rank_tbl_col$logFC
```

### Survival

Testing difference in survival outcomes for top rGBM vs GBM expressed genes. 

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Survival analysis of top rGBM-upregulated genes
# All tumor samples: GBM + rGBM
# ============================================================

genes_survival <- c(
  "COL1A1",
  "COL1A2",
  "CHI3L1",
  "IGHG1",
  "IGKC",
  "COL3A1",
  "FCGR2B",
  "SERPINE1"
)

# Confirm that all genes are present
missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_survival, rownames(expr_adj_all))

if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following genes are missing from expr_adj_all: ",
    paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Keep only tumor samples with usable survival information
survival_meta <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM"),
    !is.na(OS_days),
    !is.na(OS_event),
    OS_days > 0,
    OS_event %in% c(0, 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort),
    OS_years = OS_days / 365.25
  )

# Ensure expression columns are available
stopifnot(all(survival_meta$sample_id %in% colnames(expr_adj_all)))

# Extract expression for the seven genes
survival_expr_long <- expr_adj_all[
  genes_survival,
  survival_meta$sample_id,
  drop = FALSE
] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Gene,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(survival_meta, by = "sample_id")

# Basic checks
table(survival_expr_long$Gene)
table(survival_meta$group)
table(survival_meta$cohort)
```

```{r}
survival_expr_long <- survival_expr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    Expression_Group = ifelse(
      expression >= median_expression,
      "High",
      "Low"
    ),
    Expression_Group = factor(
      Expression_Group,
      levels = c("Low", "High")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Check group sizes
survival_expr_long %>%
  dplyr::count(Gene, Expression_Group)
```
```{r}
out_dir <- "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/Gene_Survival"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

km_plot_list <- list()
survival_stats_list <- list()


# ============================================================
# Helper function to extract Cox regression results
# ============================================================

extract_cox_stats <- function(
  cox_model,
  term = "Expression_GroupHigh"
) {

  empty_result <- tibble::tibble(
    HR = NA_real_,
    HR_lower_95CI = NA_real_,
    HR_upper_95CI = NA_real_,
    Cox_p = NA_real_
  )

  if (is.null(cox_model)) {
    return(empty_result)
  }

  cox_summary <- summary(cox_model)

  if (!term %in% rownames(cox_summary$coefficients)) {
    return(empty_result)
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    HR = unname(
      cox_summary$coefficients[
        term,
        "exp(coef)"
      ]
    ),

    HR_lower_95CI = unname(
      cox_summary$conf.int[
        term,
        "lower .95"
      ]
    ),

    HR_upper_95CI = unname(
      cox_summary$conf.int[
        term,
        "upper .95"
      ]
    ),

    Cox_p = unname(
      cox_summary$coefficients[
        term,
        "Pr(>|z|)"
      ]
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Run survival analysis for each gene
# ============================================================

for (gene_i in genes_survival) {

  gene_data <- survival_expr_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i,
      !is.na(expression),
      !is.na(Expression_Group),
      !is.na(OS_years),
      !is.na(OS_event)
    ) %>%
    droplevels()


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Kaplan-Meier model
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  km_fit <- survival::survfit(
    survival::Surv(OS_years, OS_event) ~
      Expression_Group,
    data = gene_data
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Sample sizes, events, and censored observations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  low_n <- sum(
    gene_data$Expression_Group == "Low"
  )

  high_n <- sum(
    gene_data$Expression_Group == "High"
  )

  low_events <- sum(
    gene_data$OS_event[
      gene_data$Expression_Group == "Low"
    ] == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  high_events <- sum(
    gene_data$OS_event[
      gene_data$Expression_Group == "High"
    ] == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  low_censored <- low_n - low_events
  high_censored <- high_n - high_events


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Median overall survival and 95% confidence intervals
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  median_survival_table <- survminer::surv_median(
    km_fit
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Expression_Group = sub(
        "^Expression_Group=",
        "",
        strata
      )
    )

  get_median_stat <- function(
    group_name,
    column_name
  ) {

    value <- median_survival_table[
      median_survival_table$Expression_Group ==
        group_name,
      column_name,
      drop = TRUE
    ]

    if (length(value) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    as.numeric(value[1])
  }

  low_median_OS <- get_median_stat(
    "Low",
    "median"
  )

  low_median_OS_lower <- get_median_stat(
    "Low",
    "lower"
  )

  low_median_OS_upper <- get_median_stat(
    "Low",
    "upper"
  )

  high_median_OS <- get_median_stat(
    "High",
    "median"
  )

  high_median_OS_lower <- get_median_stat(
    "High",
    "lower"
  )

  high_median_OS_upper <- get_median_stat(
    "High",
    "upper"
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Log-rank test
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  logrank_fit <- survival::survdiff(
    survival::Surv(OS_years, OS_event) ~
      Expression_Group,
    data = gene_data
  )

  logrank_chisq <- unname(
    logrank_fit$chisq
  )

  logrank_df <- length(
    logrank_fit$n
  ) - 1

  logrank_p <- stats::pchisq(
    logrank_chisq,
    df = logrank_df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Unadjusted Cox proportional-hazards model
  # High expression compared with Low expression
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  cox_unadjusted <- tryCatch(
    survival::coxph(
      survival::Surv(OS_years, OS_event) ~
        Expression_Group,
      data = gene_data
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Unadjusted Cox model failed for ",
        gene_i,
        ": ",
        e$message
      )

      NULL
    }
  )

  unadjusted_stats <- extract_cox_stats(
    cox_unadjusted
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Adjusted Cox proportional-hazards model
  # Adjusted for GBM/rGBM status and cohort
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  cox_adjusted <- tryCatch(
    survival::coxph(
      survival::Surv(OS_years, OS_event) ~
        Expression_Group +
        group +
        cohort,
      data = gene_data
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Adjusted Cox model failed for ",
        gene_i,
        ": ",
        e$message
      )

      NULL
    }
  )

  adjusted_stats <- extract_cox_stats(
    cox_adjusted
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save statistics for this gene
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  survival_stats_list[[gene_i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Gene = gene_i,

    Analysis_population =
      "GBM and rGBM tumor samples",

    Expression_group_definition =
      "High >= median; Low < median",

    HR_comparison =
      "High expression versus Low expression",

    Adjusted_model_covariates =
      "GBM/rGBM status and cohort",

    Median_expression_cutoff = median(
      gene_data$expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Total_n = nrow(gene_data),

    Total_events = sum(
      gene_data$OS_event == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Total_censored = sum(
      gene_data$OS_event == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Low_n = low_n,
    Low_events = low_events,
    Low_censored = low_censored,

    High_n = high_n,
    High_events = high_events,
    High_censored = high_censored,

    Low_median_OS_years =
      low_median_OS,

    Low_median_OS_lower_95CI =
      low_median_OS_lower,

    Low_median_OS_upper_95CI =
      low_median_OS_upper,

    High_median_OS_years =
      high_median_OS,

    High_median_OS_lower_95CI =
      high_median_OS_lower,

    High_median_OS_upper_95CI =
      high_median_OS_upper,

    Log_rank_chisq =
      logrank_chisq,

    Log_rank_df =
      logrank_df,

    Log_rank_p =
      logrank_p,

    Unadjusted_HR =
      unadjusted_stats$HR,

    Unadjusted_HR_lower_95CI =
      unadjusted_stats$HR_lower_95CI,

    Unadjusted_HR_upper_95CI =
      unadjusted_stats$HR_upper_95CI,

    Unadjusted_Cox_p =
      unadjusted_stats$Cox_p,

    Adjusted_HR =
      adjusted_stats$HR,

    Adjusted_HR_lower_95CI =
      adjusted_stats$HR_lower_95CI,

    Adjusted_HR_upper_95CI =
      adjusted_stats$HR_upper_95CI,

    Adjusted_Cox_p =
      adjusted_stats$Cox_p
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Kaplan-Meier plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  km_plot <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
    fit = km_fit,
    data = gene_data,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    pval = FALSE,
    conf.int = FALSE,
    censor = TRUE,
    palette = c("steelblue", "firebrick"),
    legend.title = gene_i,
    legend.labs = c("Low", "High"),
    xlab = "Overall survival (years)",
    ylab = "Overall survival probability",
    title = paste0(
      gene_i,
      " expression and overall survival"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "All tumor samples: GBM + rGBM | ",
      "Median expression split"
    ),
    break.time.by = 1,
    risk.table.height = 0.25,
    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  )

  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  km_plot$table <- km_plot$table +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  km_plot_list[[gene_i]] <- km_plot


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save plot with risk table
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pdf(
    file = file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        gene_i,
        "_AllTumors_KM_MedianSplit.pdf"
      )
    ),
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )

  print(km_plot)

  dev.off()
}


# ============================================================
# Combine statistics for all genes
# ============================================================

survival_stats_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  survival_stats_list
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Log_rank_FDR_BH = p.adjust(
      Log_rank_p,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    Unadjusted_Cox_FDR_BH = p.adjust(
      Unadjusted_Cox_p,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    Adjusted_Cox_FDR_BH = p.adjust(
      Adjusted_Cox_p,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels = genes_survival
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    Log_rank_FDR_BH,
    .after = Log_rank_p
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    Unadjusted_Cox_FDR_BH,
    .after = Unadjusted_Cox_p
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    Adjusted_Cox_FDR_BH,
    .after = Adjusted_Cox_p
  )


# ============================================================
# Export statistics CSV
# ============================================================

readr::write_csv(
  survival_stats_table,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "AllTumors_Gene_Survival_Statistics.csv"
  )
)


# View the completed statistics table
survival_stats_table
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate the optimal cutpoint for one gene
get_optimal_cutpoint <- function(df) {

  gene_name <- unique(df$Gene)

  cutpoint_object <- survminer::surv_cutpoint(
    data = df,
    time = "OS_years",
    event = "OS_event",
    variables = "expression",
    minprop = 0.20
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    Gene = gene_name,
    optimal_cutpoint = as.numeric(
      cutpoint_object$cutpoint[
        "expression",
        "cutpoint"
      ]
    ),
    cutpoint_statistic = as.numeric(
      cutpoint_object$cutpoint[
        "expression",
        "statistic"
      ]
    )
  )
}

optimal_cutpoints <- survival_expr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cutpoint_results = purrr::map(
      data,
      get_optimal_cutpoint
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-data) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(cutpoint_results)

optimal_cutpoints
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Define joint Collagen / TGF-β groups (all GBM)
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
  "CollagenScore" %in% colnames(sample_meta_all),
  "TGFb_score" %in% colnames(sample_meta_all),
  "OS_days" %in% colnames(sample_meta_all),
  "OS_event" %in% colnames(sample_meta_all)
)

library(dplyr)

surv_df <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CollagenScore), !is.na(TGFb_score)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(OS_days), !is.na(OS_event))

# Median cutpoints (rGBM-specific)
col_cut <- median(surv_df$CollagenScore, na.rm = TRUE)
tgfb_cut <- median(surv_df$TGFb_score, na.rm = TRUE)

surv_df <- surv_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    COL_group = ifelse(CollagenScore >= col_cut, "High", "Low"),
    TGFb_group = ifelse(TGFb_score >= tgfb_cut, "High", "Low"),
    JointGroup = dplyr::case_when(
      COL_group == "Low"  & TGFb_group == "Low"  ~ "COL_low / TGFb_low",
      COL_group == "High" & TGFb_group == "High" ~ "COL_high / TGFb_high",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(JointGroup)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    JointGroup = factor(
      JointGroup,
      levels = c("COL_low / TGFb_low", "COL_high / TGFb_high")
    )
  )

table(surv_df$JointGroup)
stopifnot(length(unique(surv_df$JointGroup)) == 2)
```

## TCGA GBM COL Analysis

Downloaded .csv form https://gliovis.bioinfo.cnio.es/. Using TCGA_GBM (RNA-seq) and selecting COL1A1, COL1A2, and COL3A1. 

```{r}
# Load TCGA collagen expression CSVs


col1a1_tcga <- read.csv("/Data/Inputs/TCGA_GBM_GLioVis_COL1A1.csv",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

col1a2_tcga <- read.csv("/Data/Inputs/TCGA_GBM_GLioVis_COL1A2.csv",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

col3a1_tcga <- read.csv("/Data/Inputs/TCGA_GBM_GLioVis_COL3A1.csv",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Check structure
colnames(col1a1_tcga)
head(col1a1_tcga)

```

```{r}
# Standardize + merge TCGA GLioVis collagen CSVs
# Columns: Histology (group), mRNA (expression)
# Groups: Non-tumor vs GBM


prep_tcga <- function(df, gene_name) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Group = Histology,
      Expression = mRNA
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gene = gene_name,
      Group = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("non", tolower(Group)) ~ "Non-tumor",
        grepl("gbm", tolower(Group)) ~ "GBM",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Non-tumor", "GBM")),
      Expression = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Expression))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Group), !is.na(Expression)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, Group, Expression)
}

tcga_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  prep_tcga(col1a1_tcga, "COL1A1"),
  prep_tcga(col1a2_tcga, "COL1A2"),
  prep_tcga(col3a1_tcga, "COL3A1")
)

# Sanity checks
table(tcga_df$Gene, tcga_df$Group)
summary(tcga_df$Expression)

```


```{r}
# T-tests per gene (Non-tumor vs GBM)


stopifnot(exists("tcga_df"))

t_test_results <- tcga_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_nontumor = sum(Group == "Non-tumor"),
    n_gbm      = sum(Group == "GBM"),
    mean_nontumor = mean(Expression[Group == "Non-tumor"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gbm      = mean(Expression[Group == "GBM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = t.test(Expression ~ Group)$p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

t_test_results

# Save table
out_dir <- "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

write.csv(
  t_test_results,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "TCGA_COL_Ttests_NonTumor_vs_GBM.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
```{r}
# Faceted boxplots (Non-tumor vs GBM) + t-test labels


tcga_plot <- ggplot(tcga_df, aes(x = Group, y = Expression, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "t.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Non-tumor" = "grey70",
      "GBM" = "firebrick"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TCGA GBM: Collagen Gene Expression",
    subtitle = "Non-tumor vs GBM",
    x = "",
    y = "mRNA expression"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(tcga_plot)

# Save PDF for Illustrator
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "TCGA_COL_Boxplots_NonTumor_vs_GBM.pdf"),
  plot     = tcga_plot,
  device   = cairo_pdf,
  width    = 5,
  height   = 3,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)
```

```{r}
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05

    neglog10FDR = -log10(p_val_adj),
    direction = case_when(
      p_val_adj < fdr_cutoff & avg_log2FC >= logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in COL High",
      p_val_adj < fdr_cutoff & avg_log2FC <= -logfc_cutoff ~ "Up in COL Low",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

collagen_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

stopifnot(
  all(collagen_genes %in% rownames(expr_gbm)),

  )

# Create one row per GBM dot

  barcode = dot_meta_gbm$barcode,
  sample = dot_meta_gbm$sample,
  COL1A1 = collagen_expr[, "COL1A1"],
  COL1A2 = collagen_expr[, "COL1A2"],
  COL3A1 = collagen_expr[, "COL3A1"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

  identical(collagen_df$barcode, dot_meta_gbm$barcode)
)
```

```{r}
# Expression-value summaries
summary(
  collagen_df[, collagen_genes]
)

# Percentage of GBM dots with nonzero expression
collagen_detection <- data.frame(
  Gene = collagen_genes,
  Dots_detected = sapply(
    collagen_df[, collagen_genes],
    function(x) sum(x > 0)
  ),
  Percent_detected = sapply(
    collagen_df[, collagen_genes],
    function(x) mean(x > 0) * 100
  )
)

collagen_detection
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 2: Calculate global collagen score across all GBM dots
# ============================================================

# Number of collagen genes detected in each dot
collagen_df$n_collagen_detected <- rowSums(
  collagen_df[, collagen_genes, drop = FALSE] > 0
)

# Globally standardize each collagen gene across all GBM dots
collagen_z <- scale(
  collagen_df[, collagen_genes, drop = FALSE],
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE
)

colnames(collagen_z) <- paste0(collagen_genes, "_z")

# Mean standardized expression of COL1A1, COL1A2, and COL3A1
collagen_df$collagen_score <- rowMeans(collagen_z)

# Add individual z-scores for reference
collagen_df <- cbind(
  collagen_df,
  as.data.frame(collagen_z)
)

# Quality checks
stopifnot(
  nrow(collagen_df) == nrow(dot_meta_gbm),
  !anyNA(collagen_df$collagen_score)
)

cat("Global collagen score calculated successfully.\n")
```

```{r}
collagen_df$collagen_group <- ifelse(

  "COL_High",
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Blocked heatmap:

#
# Samples lacking one collagen category are retained.
# Gray tiles indicate that the sample had no dots assigned
# to that collagen category.

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

heatmap_out_dir <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Heatmaps"

if (!dir.exists(heatmap_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    heatmap_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Set plotting order

sample_order <- sort(
  unique(gene_expression_long$sample)
)

collagen_group_order <- c(
  "COL_Low",
  "COL_High"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check which samples lack COL_Low or COL_High dots
# ------------------------------------------------------------

  dplyr::distinct(
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = as.character(collagen_group)
  ) %>%

    sample = sample_order,
    collagen_group = collagen_group_order

  dplyr::distinct(
    barcode,

    collagen_group

  dplyr::count(

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = as.character(collagen_group)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    sample = sample_order,
    collagen_group = collagen_group_order,
    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    sample,
    factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = collagen_group_order
    )
  )

# Display samples missing one collagen category
sample_group_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_dots == 0)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate mean gene expression within each sample and
# collagen category
#
# All available dots are included, including dots with
# zero target-gene expression.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_summary <- gene_expression_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),
    collagen_group = as.character(collagen_group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    mean_expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    percent_detected = 100 * mean(
      Expression > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add missing Gene × Sample × Collagen-group combinations
#
# Missing categories receive:
#   n_dots = 0
#   expression = NA
#
# NA is different from zero expression.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_summary_complete <- gene_sample_summary %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Gene = genes_to_plot,
    sample = sample_order,
    collagen_group = collagen_group_order,
    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_expression = NA_real_,
      percent_detected = NA_real_
    )
  )

# Confirm that every gene/sample now has two rows
group_check <- gene_sample_summary_complete %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Gene,
    sample,
    name = "n_groups"
  )

stopifnot(
  all(group_check$n_groups == 2)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate gene-wise z-scores using only available values
#
# Missing sample-category combinations remain NA.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_heatmap <- gene_sample_summary_complete %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_mean = mean(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    gene_sd = stats::sd(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_expression_z = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(mean_expression) ~ NA_real_,

      is.na(gene_sd) ~ 0,

      gene_sd == 0 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ (
        mean_expression - gene_mean
      ) / gene_sd
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order
    ),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = collagen_group_order
    ),

    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels = rev(genes_to_plot)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create blocked heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_gene_heatmap_blocked <- ggplot(
  gene_sample_heatmap,
  aes(
    x = sample,
    y = Gene,
    fill = mean_expression_z
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(collagen_group),
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "steelblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-2, 2),
    oob = scales::squish,

    # Gray means that sample had no dots in that category
    na.value = "grey75",

    name = "Relative mean\nexpression"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Gene expression in collagen-low and collagen-high GBM regions",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Mean expression across all available spatial dots; ",
      "gray indicates no dots in that sample category"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 10
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey92",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.35,
      "cm"
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )
  )

print(p_gene_heatmap_blocked)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save blocked heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    heatmap_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_COLLow_COLHigh_Blocked_Heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_gene_heatmap_blocked,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 9,
  height = 3.5,
  units = "in"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save underlying values
# ------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(
  gene_sample_heatmap,
  file = file.path(
    heatmap_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_COLLow_COLHigh_Blocked_Heatmap_Data.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  sample_group_counts,
  file = file.path(
    heatmap_out_dir,
    "Sample_CollagenGroup_Dot_Counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Sample-level paired analysis:
# Mean gene expression in COL_Low vs COL_High regions
#
# Experimental unit = individual GBM tumor
#
# All available dots contribute to each sample-level mean,
# including dots with zero target-gene expression.
#
# Samples missing COL_Low or COL_High remain in the output,
# but cannot contribute to the paired statistical test.
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

analysis_out_dir <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Sample_Level_Analysis"
)

if (!dir.exists(analysis_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    analysis_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

sample_order <- sort(
  unique(gene_expression_long$sample)
)

collagen_group_order <- c(
  "COL_Low",
  "COL_High"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: Calculate one mean per:
# Gene × Sample × Collagen group
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_means_long <- gene_expression_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),
    collagen_group = as.character(collagen_group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    # Mean includes zero-expression dots
    mean_expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    percent_detected = 100 * mean(
      Expression > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Retain missing sample/group combinations as NA
  tidyr::complete(
    Gene = genes_to_plot,
    sample = sample_order,
    collagen_group = collagen_group_order,
    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_expression = NA_real_,
      percent_detected = NA_real_
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2: Put COL_Low and COL_High side by side
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_pairs <- gene_sample_means_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = collagen_group,
    values_from = c(
      n_dots,
      mean_expression,
      percent_detected
    ),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_pair =
      !is.na(mean_expression__COL_Low) &
      !is.na(mean_expression__COL_High),

    mean_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      has_pair,
      mean_expression__COL_High -
        mean_expression__COL_Low,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Inspect samples that cannot contribute to paired testing
gene_sample_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(!has_pair) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    sample,
    n_dots__COL_Low,
    n_dots__COL_High
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: Safe paired Wilcoxon-test function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
paired_wilcox_p <- function(low, high) {

  keep <- stats::complete.cases(
    low,
    high
  )

  low <- low[keep]
  high <- high[keep]

  if (length(low) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  differences <- high - low

  # If every paired difference is zero
  if (all(differences == 0)) {
    return(1)
  }

  suppressWarnings(
    stats::wilcox.test(
      x = high,
      y = low,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 4: Run paired analysis for each selected gene
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_paired_statistics <- gene_sample_pairs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total_samples = dplyr::n(),

    n_paired_samples = sum(
      has_pair
    ),

    mean_COL_Low = mean(
      mean_expression__COL_Low[has_pair],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_COL_High = mean(
      mean_expression__COL_High[has_pair],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_difference = mean(
      mean_difference[has_pair],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_difference = median(
      mean_difference[has_pair],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_higher_in_COL_High = sum(
      mean_difference > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_higher_in_COL_Low = sum(
      mean_difference < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_with_no_difference = sum(
      mean_difference == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    p_value = paired_wilcox_p(
      mean_expression__COL_Low,
      mean_expression__COL_High
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Correct across the selected gene panel
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::arrange(
    FDR,
    p_value
  )

gene_paired_statistics


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 5: Save analysis tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(
  gene_sample_means_long,
  file = file.path(
    analysis_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_SampleLevel_Means_Long.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  gene_sample_pairs,
  file = file.path(
    analysis_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_SampleLevel_Paired_Values.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  gene_paired_statistics,
  file = file.path(
    analysis_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_COLHigh_vs_COLLow_Paired_Statistics.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Paired sample-level gene-expression plots
#
# Each point = mean expression within one GBM sample
# Gray lines connect COL_Low and COL_High regions
# from the same tumor.
#
# All dots, including zero-expression dots, contributed
# to each sample-level mean.
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_out_dir <- file.path(
  analysis_out_dir,
  "Paired_Plots"
)

if (!dir.exists(plot_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    plot_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare statistical labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_stat_labels <- gene_paired_statistics %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "p = NA",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "p = ",
        formatC(
          p_value,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    fdr_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(FDR) ~ "FDR = NA",
      FDR < 0.001 ~ "FDR < 0.001",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "FDR = ",
        formatC(
          FDR,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    facet_label = paste0(
      Gene,
      "\n",
      p_label,
      "; ",
      fdr_label,
      "\npaired n = ",
      n_paired_samples
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    facet_label
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare sample-level plotting data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_plot_data <- gene_sample_means_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_stat_labels,
    by = "Gene"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify complete sample pairs for connecting lines
# ------------------------------------------------------------
paired_line_data <- gene_sample_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_expression)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::n_distinct(collagen_group) == 2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Preserve requested gene order
facet_order <- gene_stat_labels %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Gene %in% genes_to_plot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice(
    match(
      genes_to_plot,
      Gene
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    facet_label
  )

gene_sample_plot_data$facet_label <- factor(
  gene_sample_plot_data$facet_label,
  levels = facet_order
)

paired_line_data$facet_label <- factor(
  paired_line_data$facet_label,
  levels = facet_order
)

# ============================================================
# Combined faceted plot
# ============================================================

p_gene_paired <- ggplot(
  gene_sample_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = collagen_group,
    y = mean_expression
  )
) +

  # Connect COL_Low and COL_High values from the same tumor
  geom_line(
    data = paired_line_data,
    aes(
      group = sample
    ),
    color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # One point per tumor and collagen category
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = collagen_group
    ),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.035,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 2.3,
    alpha = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Show the overall mean of the sample-level values
  stat_summary(
    aes(
      group = collagen_group
    ),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
      "COL_High" = "firebrick"
    )
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ facet_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.08)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Gene expression in collagen-low and collagen-high GBM regions",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Each point represents one tumor; black diamonds show ",
      "group means"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean processed expression",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    strip.background = element_blank(),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.4,
      "cm"
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

print(p_gene_paired)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_COLLow_vs_COLHigh_Paired_AllGenes.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_gene_paired,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 12,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)


# ============================================================
# Save one paired plot per gene
# ============================================================

for (gene_i in genes_to_plot) {

  df_gene <- gene_sample_plot_data %>%

  fdr_text <- dplyr::case_when(

  )

  p_gene <- ggplot(

      ),

    ) +

    stat_summary(

      ),

    labs(

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

    theme(

  print(p_gene)

  ggsave(

  )
}
```

#### Remove leading edge as non-tumor control

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered tumor-region analysis
#
# Retain:
#   CT = cellular tumor
#   IT = infiltrating tumor
#
# Exclude:
#   LE = leading edge / more normal-brain-enriched region
#
# Original objects are not overwritten.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Confirm required metadata and alignment
# ------------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(
  "AF_CNV" %in% colnames(dot_meta_gbm),
  identical(
    dot_meta_gbm$barcode,
    colnames(expr_gbm)
  )
)

# Inspect categories before filtering
table(
  dot_meta_gbm$AF_CNV,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Retain CT and IT spatial dots
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cnv_keep <- dot_meta_gbm$AF_CNV %in% c(
  "CT",
  "IT"
)

dot_meta_gbm_cnv <- dot_meta_gbm[
  cnv_keep,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

expr_gbm_cnv <- expr_gbm[
  ,
  cnv_keep,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  nrow(dot_meta_gbm_cnv) == ncol(expr_gbm_cnv),
  identical(
    dot_meta_gbm_cnv$barcode,
    colnames(expr_gbm_cnv)
  ),
  all(
    dot_meta_gbm_cnv$AF_CNV %in% c("CT", "IT")
  )
)

cat(
  "Original GBM dots:",
  nrow(dot_meta_gbm),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "CT/IT retained dots:",
  nrow(dot_meta_gbm_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Dots removed:",
  sum(!cnv_keep),
  "\n"
)

table(
  dot_meta_gbm_cnv$AF_CNV,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

table(
  dot_meta_gbm_cnv$sample
)


# ============================================================
# Recalculate collagen score using only CT/IT dots
# ============================================================

collagen_genes <- c(
  "COL1A1",
  "COL1A2",
  "COL3A1"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    collagen_genes %in% rownames(expr_gbm_cnv)
  )
)

# Extract the three collagen genes
collagen_expr_cnv <- t(
  as.matrix(
    expr_gbm_cnv[
      collagen_genes,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )
)

collagen_df_cnv <- data.frame(
  barcode = dot_meta_gbm_cnv$barcode,
  sample = dot_meta_gbm_cnv$sample,

  COL1A1 = collagen_expr_cnv[, "COL1A1"],
  COL1A2 = collagen_expr_cnv[, "COL1A2"],
  COL3A1 = collagen_expr_cnv[, "COL3A1"],

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Number of collagen genes detected per dot
collagen_df_cnv$n_collagen_detected <- rowSums(
  collagen_df_cnv[
    ,
    collagen_genes,
    drop = FALSE
  ] > 0
)

# Gene-wise z-score calculated within the CT/IT dots
collagen_z_cnv <- scale(
  collagen_df_cnv[
    ,
    collagen_genes,
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE
)

colnames(collagen_z_cnv) <- paste0(
  collagen_genes,
  "_z"
)

# Mean of the three collagen-gene z-scores
collagen_df_cnv$collagen_score <- rowMeans(
  collagen_z_cnv
)

collagen_df_cnv <- cbind(
  collagen_df_cnv,
  as.data.frame(collagen_z_cnv)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create new global median cutoff using CT/IT dots only
# ------------------------------------------------------------
global_collagen_cutoff_cnv <- median(
  collagen_df_cnv$collagen_score,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

collagen_df_cnv$collagen_group <- ifelse(
  collagen_df_cnv$collagen_score >
    global_collagen_cutoff_cnv,
  "COL_High",
  "COL_Low"
)

collagen_df_cnv$collagen_group <- factor(
  collagen_df_cnv$collagen_group,
  levels = c(
```
