```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered blocked heatmap
#
# Left block:  COL_Low CT/IT regions
# Right block: COL_High CT/IT regions
#
# Each tile = mean gene expression within one tumor and
# collagen category.
#
# Color = gene-wise z-score of sample-level mean expression.
# Gray = that tumor had no dots in that collagen category.
# ============================================================


cnv_heatmap_out_dir <- "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered/Heatmaps"

if (!dir.exists(cnv_heatmap_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    cnv_heatmap_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Set sample and group order
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sample_order_cnv <- sort(
  unique(gene_expression_long_cnv$sample)
)

collagen_group_order_cnv <- c(
  "COL_Low",
  "COL_High"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate sample-level mean expression
#
# All CT/IT dots are included, including target-gene zeros
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_summary_cnv <- gene_expression_long_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),
    collagen_group = as.character(collagen_group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    mean_expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    percent_detected = 100 * mean(
      Expression > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add missing sample/category combinations
#
# Missing category:
#   n_dots = 0
#   mean expression = NA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_summary_cnv_complete <- gene_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Gene = genes_to_plot_cnv,
    sample = sample_order_cnv,
    collagen_group = collagen_group_order_cnv,
    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_expression = NA_real_,
      percent_detected = NA_real_
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate gene-wise z-scores
#
# Z-scores are only for heatmap visualization.
# Raw mean_expression will be used for statistics.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_sample_heatmap_cnv <- gene_sample_summary_cnv_complete %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_mean = mean(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    gene_sd = stats::sd(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_expression_z = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(mean_expression) ~ NA_real_,
      is.na(gene_sd) ~ 0,
      gene_sd == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ (
        mean_expression - gene_mean
      ) / gene_sd
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order_cnv
    ),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = collagen_group_order_cnv
    ),

    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels = rev(genes_to_plot_cnv)
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create blocked heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_gene_heatmap_cnv <- ggplot(
  gene_sample_heatmap_cnv,
  aes(
    x = sample,
    y = Gene,
    fill = mean_expression_z
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(collagen_group),
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "steelblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-2, 2),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "grey75",
    name = "Mean expression\nz-score"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Gene expression in CNV-filtered GBM regions",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "CT and IT dots only; gray indicates no dots ",
      "in that tumor category"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 10
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey92",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.35,
      "cm"
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )
  )

print(p_gene_heatmap_cnv)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    cnv_heatmap_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_CNVFiltered_COLLow_COLHigh_Heatmap.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_gene_heatmap_cnv,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 9,
  height = 3.5,
  units = "in"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save underlying raw and z-scored values
# ------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(
  gene_sample_heatmap_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    cnv_heatmap_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_CNVFiltered_Heatmap_Data.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered paired sample-level gene-expression plots
#
# Each point = mean expression within one GBM tumor region
# CT and IT dots only
#
# Gray lines connect COL_Low and COL_High values from
# the same tumor.
#
# Black diamonds show group means using paired tumors only.
#
# Each gene panel:
#   - begins at 0
#   - ends at a clean rounded value
#   - displays the upper limit as a labeled tick
# ============================================================


cnv_analysis_out_dir <-
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered/Paired_Analysis"

if (!dir.exists(cnv_analysis_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    cnv_analysis_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Put COL_Low and COL_High means side by side
# ============================================================

gene_sample_pairs_cnv <- gene_sample_summary_cnv_complete %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = collagen_group,
    values_from = c(
      n_dots,
      mean_expression,
      percent_detected
    ),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_pair =
      !is.na(mean_expression__COL_Low) &
      !is.na(mean_expression__COL_High),

    mean_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      has_pair,
      mean_expression__COL_High -
        mean_expression__COL_Low,
      NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. Safe paired Wilcoxon-test function
# ============================================================

paired_wilcox_cnv <- function(low, high) {

  keep <- stats::complete.cases(
    low,
    high
  )

  low <- low[keep]
  high <- high[keep]

  if (length(low) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  differences <- high - low

  if (all(differences == 0)) {
    return(1)
  }

  suppressWarnings(
    stats::wilcox.test(
      x = high,
      y = low,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Run paired analysis across tumors
# ============================================================

gene_paired_statistics_cnv <- gene_sample_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total_samples = dplyr::n(),

    n_paired_samples = sum(
      has_pair
    ),

    mean_COL_Low = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_expression__COL_Low[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_COL_High = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_expression__COL_High[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_difference = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_difference[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    median_difference = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      median(
        mean_difference[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    tumors_higher_in_COL_High = sum(
      mean_difference > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_higher_in_COL_Low = sum(
      mean_difference < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_with_no_difference = sum(
      mean_difference == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    p_value = paired_wilcox_cnv(
      mean_expression__COL_Low,
      mean_expression__COL_High
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    FDR,
    p_value
  )

gene_paired_statistics_cnv


# ============================================================
# 4. Create statistical labels
# ============================================================

gene_stat_labels_cnv <- gene_paired_statistics_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "p = NA",

      p_value < 0.001 ~
        "p < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "p = ",
        formatC(
          p_value,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    fdr_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(FDR) ~ "FDR = NA",

      FDR < 0.001 ~
        "FDR < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "FDR = ",
        formatC(
          FDR,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    facet_label = paste0(
      Gene,
      "\n",
      p_label,
      "; ",
      fdr_label,
      "\npaired n = ",
      n_paired_samples
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    facet_label
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Prepare plotting data
# ============================================================

gene_sample_plot_cnv <- gene_sample_summary_cnv_complete %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_stat_labels_cnv,
    by = "Gene"
  )


# Identify tumors containing both collagen categories
paired_sample_ids_cnv <- gene_sample_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    has_pair
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    sample
  )


# Data used for gray paired lines and black diamonds
paired_plot_data_cnv <- gene_sample_plot_cnv %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    paired_sample_ids_cnv,
    by = c(
      "Gene",
      "sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_expression)
  )


# Preserve the requested gene order
facet_order_cnv <- gene_stat_labels_cnv %>%
  dplyr::slice(
    match(
      genes_to_plot_cnv,
      Gene
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    facet_label
  )

gene_sample_plot_cnv$facet_label <- factor(
  gene_sample_plot_cnv$facet_label,
  levels = facet_order_cnv
)

paired_plot_data_cnv$facet_label <- factor(
  paired_plot_data_cnv$facet_label,
  levels = facet_order_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Calculate a clean upper y-axis value for each gene
# ============================================================

gene_axis_limits_cnv <- gene_sample_plot_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_expression)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    facet_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    data_max = max(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_axis_top = vapply(
      data_max,
      function(x) {

        if (!is.finite(x) || x <= 0) {
          return(1)
        }

        # Add approximately 8% space and round upward
        # to a clean axis value
        max(
          pretty(
            c(
              0,
              x * 1.08
            ),
            n = 4
          )
        )
      },
      numeric(1)
    ),

    facet_label = factor(
      facet_label,
      levels = facet_order_cnv
    )
  )


# Create invisible points at 0 and the upper axis value
# so that every panel starts and ends exactly there
axis_anchor_data_cnv <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  gene_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene,
      facet_label,
      collagen_group = factor(
        "COL_Low",
        levels = c(
          "COL_Low",
          "COL_High"
        )
      ),
      axis_value = 0
    ),

  gene_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene,
      facet_label,
      collagen_group = factor(
        "COL_Low",
        levels = c(
          "COL_Low",
          "COL_High"
        )
      ),
      axis_value = y_axis_top
    )
)

gene_axis_limits_cnv


# ============================================================
# 7. Create and save one paired plot per gene
# ============================================================

# Optional: retain every plot in an R list
p_gene_paired_cnv_list <- list()

for (gene_i in genes_to_plot_cnv) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Subset data for the current gene
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  plot_data_i <- gene_sample_plot_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i,
      !is.na(mean_expression)
    )

  paired_data_i <- paired_plot_data_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i,
      !is.na(mean_expression)
    )

  axis_info_i <- gene_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i
    )

  stat_info_i <- gene_paired_statistics_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i
    )

  # Skip genes without plotting data
  if (
    nrow(plot_data_i) == 0 ||
    nrow(axis_info_i) == 0
  ) {

    warning(
      paste0(
        "Skipping ",
        gene_i,
        ": no available plotting data."
      )
    )

    next
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract the gene-specific y-axis limit
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  y_axis_top_i <- axis_info_i$y_axis_top[[1]]


  # Create clean breaks while forcing 0 and the upper
  # limit to appear as labeled ticks
  y_breaks_i <- sort(
    unique(
      c(
        0,
        pretty(
          c(
            0,
            y_axis_top_i
          ),
          n = 4
        ),
        y_axis_top_i
      )
    )
  )

  # Remove breaks outside the desired axis limits
  y_breaks_i <- y_breaks_i[
    y_breaks_i >= 0 &
      y_breaks_i <= y_axis_top_i
  ]


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create statistical subtitle
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (nrow(stat_info_i) == 1) {

    p_label_i <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(stat_info_i$p_value) ~
        "p = NA",

      stat_info_i$p_value < 0.001 ~
        "p < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "p = ",
        formatC(
          stat_info_i$p_value,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    )

    fdr_label_i <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(stat_info_i$FDR) ~
        "FDR = NA",

      stat_info_i$FDR < 0.001 ~
        "FDR < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "FDR = ",
        formatC(
          stat_info_i$FDR,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    )

    subtitle_i <- paste0(
      "CT and IT regions only; paired Wilcoxon test\n",
      p_label_i,
      "; ",
      fdr_label_i,
      "; paired n = ",
      stat_info_i$n_paired_samples
    )

  } else {

    subtitle_i <- paste0(
      "CT and IT regions only; ",
      "paired statistics unavailable"
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create the gene-specific plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  p_gene_i <- ggplot(
    plot_data_i,
    aes(
      x = collagen_group,
      y = mean_expression
    )
  ) +

    # Connect COL_Low and COL_High values
    # from the same paired tumor
    geom_line(
      data = paired_data_i,
      aes(
        group = sample
      ),
      color = "grey65",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +

    # Show sample-level mean expression
    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = collagen_group
      ),
      position = position_jitter(
        width = 0.035,
        height = 0,
        seed = 123
      ),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.9,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    # Black diamonds show group means calculated
    # from paired tumors only
    stat_summary(
      data = paired_data_i,
      aes(
        group = collagen_group
      ),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 18,
      size = 4,
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
        "COL_High" = "firebrick"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        0,
        y_axis_top_i
      ),
      breaks = y_breaks_i,
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0
        )
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = gene_i,
      subtitle = subtitle_i,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean processed expression",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "top",

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 9
      )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Print and retain the plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  print(
    p_gene_i
  )

  p_gene_paired_cnv_list[[gene_i]] <- p_gene_i


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create a safe output filename
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  gene_filename_i <- gsub(
    pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]",
    replacement = "_",
    x = gene_i
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save the current gene as its own PDF
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      cnv_analysis_out_dir,
      paste0(
        gene_filename_i,
        "_GeneExpression_CNVFiltered_",
        "COLLow_vs_COLHigh_Paired.pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_gene_i,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 4,
    height = 4.5,
    units = "in"
  )
}


# Confirm the genes for which plots were generated
names(
  p_gene_paired_cnv_list
)

# ============================================================
# 9. Save underlying statistical results
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  gene_sample_pairs_cnv,
  file = file.path(

write.csv(

  file = file.path(
    cnv_analysis_out_dir,
    "GeneExpression_CNVFiltered_Paired_Statistics.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Calculate immune marker-program scores
# CNV-filtered CT/IT dots only
#
# Score definition:
#   1. Z-score each marker gene across all retained CT/IT dots
#   2. Average the marker-gene z-scores within each program
#
# These scores represent relative enrichment of a marker
# program. They are not direct cell counts or cell fractions.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define immune marker programs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
immune_markers_cnv <- list(

  Regulatory_T_cells = c(
    "FOXP3",
    "IL2RA",
    "CTLA4",
    "TIGIT"
  ),

  Exhausted_T_cells = c(
    "PDCD1",
    "HAVCR2",
    "LAG3",
    "TOX"
  ),

  Naive_T_cells = c(
    "CCR7",
    "SELL",
    "TCF7",
    "LEF1"
  ),

  NK_cells = c(
    "NCAM1",
    "KLRB1",
    "KLRD1",
    "NCR1"
  ),

  NKT_cells = c(
    "CD3E",
    "NCAM1",
    "KLRB1",
    "CD8A"
  ),

  M1_macrophage = c(
    "CD86",
    "NOS2",
    "TNF",
    "IL1B"
  ),

  M2_macrophage = c(
    "CD163",
    "MRC1",
    "MSR1",
    "ARG1"
  ),

  DC_cells = c(
    "CD1C",
    "CLEC9A",
    "BATF3",
    "FLT3"
  ),

  P_MDSC = c(
    "CD14",
    "HLA-DRA",
    "S100A8",
    "S100A9"
  ),

  M_MDSC = c(
    "CD14",
    "CD33",
    "ARG1",
    "NOS2"
  ),

  M1_Microglia = c(
    "TMEM119",
    "P2RY12",
    "CX3CR1",
    "TNF"
  ),

  M2_Microglia = c(
    "TMEM119",
    "P2RY12",
    "CX3CR1",
    "MRC1"
  ),

  B_cells = c(
    "CD79A",
    "CD79B",
    "MS4A1",
    "CD19"
  ),

  Neutrophil = c(
    "FCGR3B",
    "CSF3R",
    "CXCR2",
    "S100A12"
  ),

  CD4_T_cells = c(
    "CD3E",
    "CD4",
    "IL7R"
  ),

  CD8_T_cells = c(
    "CD3E",
    "CD8A",
    "CD8B"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Confirm all marker genes are available
# ============================================================

all_immune_genes_cnv <- unique(
  unlist(
    immune_markers_cnv,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)

missing_immune_genes_cnv <- setdiff(
  all_immune_genes_cnv,
  rownames(expr_gbm_cnv)
)

cat(
  "Number of unique immune marker genes:",
  length(all_immune_genes_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Missing marker genes:",
  length(missing_immune_genes_cnv),
  "\n"
)

if (length(missing_immune_genes_cnv) > 0) {
  print(missing_immune_genes_cnv)
}

stopifnot(
  length(missing_immune_genes_cnv) == 0
)


# ============================================================
# Extract marker-gene expression
#
# Rows = spatial dots
# Columns = immune marker genes
# ============================================================

immune_expression_matrix_cnv <- t(
  as.matrix(
    expr_gbm_cnv[
      all_immune_genes_cnv,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(immune_expression_matrix_cnv) ==
    nrow(dot_meta_gbm_cnv),

  identical(
    rownames(immune_expression_matrix_cnv),
    dot_meta_gbm_cnv$barcode
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Gene-wise standardization across CT/IT dots
# ============================================================

immune_gene_means_cnv <- colMeans(
  immune_expression_matrix_cnv,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

immune_gene_sds_cnv <- apply(
  immune_expression_matrix_cnv,
  2,
  stats::sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Genes with no variation cannot be standardized.
# Assigning an SD of 1 makes their standardized values 0.
immune_gene_sds_cnv[
  is.na(immune_gene_sds_cnv) |
    immune_gene_sds_cnv == 0
] <- 1

immune_expression_z_cnv <- sweep(
  immune_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = immune_gene_means_cnv,
  FUN = "-"
)

immune_expression_z_cnv <- sweep(
  immune_expression_z_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = immune_gene_sds_cnv,
  FUN = "/"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    is.finite(immune_expression_z_cnv)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Calculate immune marker-program scores
# ============================================================

immune_score_matrix_cnv <- sapply(
  names(immune_markers_cnv),
  function(program_i) {

    program_genes <- immune_markers_cnv[[program_i]]

    rowMeans(
      immune_expression_z_cnv[
        ,
        program_genes,
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }
)

immune_score_matrix_cnv <- as.data.frame(
  immune_score_matrix_cnv,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Combine immune scores with dot metadata
# ============================================================

immune_scores_cnv <- dplyr::bind_cols(

  dot_meta_gbm_cnv %>%
    dplyr::select(
      barcode,
      sample,
      AF_CNV,
      collagen_group,
      collagen_score
    ),

  immune_score_matrix_cnv
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(immune_scores_cnv) ==
    nrow(dot_meta_gbm_cnv),

  identical(
    immune_scores_cnv$barcode,
    dot_meta_gbm_cnv$barcode
  )
)

dim(immune_scores_cnv)

head(
  immune_scores_cnv[
    ,
    1:10
  ]
)


# ============================================================
# Convert immune scores to long format
#
# One row represents:
#   one spatial dot × one immune marker program
# ============================================================

immune_score_long_cnv <- immune_scores_cnv %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      names(immune_markers_cnv)
    ),
    names_to = "Immune_program",
    values_to = "Immune_score"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    ),

    Immune_program = factor(
      Immune_program,
      levels = names(
        immune_markers_cnv
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Validate immune-score results
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
  nrow(immune_score_long_cnv) ==
    nrow(immune_scores_cnv) *
    length(immune_markers_cnv),

  all(
    immune_score_long_cnv$AF_CNV %in%
      c("CT", "IT")
  ),

  all(
    is.finite(
      immune_score_long_cnv$Immune_score
    )
  )
)

dim(immune_score_long_cnv)

summary(
  immune_score_long_cnv$Immune_score
)

# Summary of every immune program
immune_program_summary_cnv <- immune_score_long_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Immune_program
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    minimum_score = min(
      Immune_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_score = median(
      Immune_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_score = mean(
      Immune_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    maximum_score = max(
      Immune_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

immune_program_summary_cnv
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Paired analysis of ALL immune marker-program scores
# CNV-filtered CT/IT regions only
#
# Each point = one tumor-level mean immune score
# Gray lines = paired COL_Low and COL_High values
# Black diamonds = group means among paired tumors only
#
# Statistical test:
#   Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test
#   BH correction across ALL immune programs
# ============================================================

immune_analysis_out_dir <- file.path(
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered",
  "All_Immune_Score_Paired_Analysis"
)

individual_plot_out_dir <- file.path(
  immune_analysis_out_dir,
  "Individual_Plots"
)

if (!dir.exists(immune_analysis_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    immune_analysis_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

if (!dir.exists(individual_plot_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    individual_plot_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Include every immune marker program
# ============================================================

immune_programs_to_plot_cnv <- names(
  immune_markers_cnv
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    immune_programs_to_plot_cnv %in%
      unique(
        as.character(
          immune_score_long_cnv$Immune_program
        )
      )
  )
)

# Cleaner display labels
immune_program_labels_cnv <- c(
  "Regulatory_T_cells" = "Regulatory T cells",
  "Exhausted_T_cells" = "Exhausted T cells",
  "Naive_T_cells" = "Naive T cells",
  "NK_cells" = "NK cells",
  "NKT_cells" = "NKT cells",
  "M1_macrophage" = "M1 macrophage",
  "M2_macrophage" = "M2 macrophage",
  "DC_cells" = "Dendritic cells",
  "P_MDSC" = "P-MDSC",
  "M_MDSC" = "M-MDSC",
  "M1_Microglia" = "M1 microglia",
  "M2_Microglia" = "M2 microglia",
  "B_cells" = "B cells",
  "Neutrophil" = "Neutrophils",
  "CD4_T_cells" = "CD4 T cells",
  "CD8_T_cells" = "CD8 T cells"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    immune_programs_to_plot_cnv %in%
      names(immune_program_labels_cnv)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Calculate tumor-level immune scores
#
# One mean score for each:
#   Immune program × tumor × collagen group
# ============================================================

sample_order_immune_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    immune_score_long_cnv$sample
  )
)

immune_sample_summary_cnv <- immune_score_long_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(Immune_program) %in%
      immune_programs_to_plot_cnv
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Immune_program = as.character(
      Immune_program
    ),

    collagen_group = as.character(
      collagen_group
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Immune_program,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    mean_immune_score = mean(
      Immune_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_immune_score = median(
      Immune_score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Immune_program = immune_programs_to_plot_cnv,
    sample = sample_order_immune_cnv,
    collagen_group = c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    ),
    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_immune_score = NA_real_,
      median_immune_score = NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Put COL_Low and COL_High values side by side
# ============================================================

immune_sample_pairs_cnv <- immune_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = collagen_group,
    values_from = c(
      n_dots,
      mean_immune_score,
      median_immune_score
    ),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_pair =
      !is.na(mean_immune_score__COL_Low) &
      !is.na(mean_immune_score__COL_High),

    score_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      has_pair,
      mean_immune_score__COL_High -
        mean_immune_score__COL_Low,
      NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Safe paired Wilcoxon-test function
# ============================================================

paired_wilcox_immune_cnv <- function(low, high) {

  keep <- stats::complete.cases(
    low,
    high
  )

  low <- low[keep]
  high <- high[keep]

  if (length(low) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  differences <- high - low

  if (all(differences == 0)) {
    return(1)
  }

  suppressWarnings(
    stats::wilcox.test(
      x = high,
      y = low,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. Run paired tests for all immune programs
# ============================================================

immune_paired_statistics_cnv <- immune_sample_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Immune_program
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total_samples = dplyr::n(),

    n_paired_samples = sum(
      has_pair
    ),

    mean_COL_Low = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_immune_score__COL_Low[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_COL_High = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_immune_score__COL_High[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_difference = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        score_difference[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    median_difference = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      median(
        score_difference[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    tumors_higher_in_COL_High = sum(
      score_difference > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_higher_in_COL_Low = sum(
      score_difference < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_with_no_difference = sum(
      score_difference == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    p_value = paired_wilcox_immune_cnv(
      mean_immune_score__COL_Low,
      mean_immune_score__COL_High
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # FDR correction across all 16 immune programs
    FDR = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    display_name = unname(
      immune_program_labels_cnv[
        Immune_program
      ]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    FDR,
    p_value
  )

immune_paired_statistics_cnv


# ============================================================
# 6. Create statistical facet labels
# ============================================================

immune_stat_labels_cnv <- immune_paired_statistics_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~
        "p = NA",

      p_value < 0.001 ~
        "p < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "p = ",
        formatC(
          p_value,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    fdr_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(FDR) ~
        "FDR = NA",

      FDR < 0.001 ~
        "FDR < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "FDR = ",
        formatC(
          FDR,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    facet_label = paste0(
      display_name,
      "\n",
      p_label,
      "; ",
      fdr_label,
      "\npaired n = ",
      n_paired_samples
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Immune_program,
    display_name,
    facet_label
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Prepare plotting data
# ============================================================

immune_sample_plot_cnv <- immune_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    immune_stat_labels_cnv,
    by = "Immune_program"
  )

# Identify tumors containing both collagen groups
paired_immune_sample_ids_cnv <- immune_sample_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    has_pair
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Immune_program,
    sample
  )

# Paired data used for lines and black diamonds
paired_immune_plot_data_cnv <- immune_sample_plot_cnv %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    paired_immune_sample_ids_cnv,
    by = c(
      "Immune_program",
      "sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_immune_score)
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. Preserve marker-program order
# ============================================================

facet_order_immune_cnv <- immune_stat_labels_cnv %>%
  dplyr::slice(
    match(
      immune_programs_to_plot_cnv,
      Immune_program
    )
  ) %>%

immune_sample_plot_cnv$facet_label <- factor(

  levels = facet_order_immune_cnv

paired_immune_plot_data_cnv$facet_label <- factor(

# ============================================================
# 9. Calculate clean y-axis limits
#
# Immune scores can be negative.
# Each panel receives an independent rounded range.
# ============================================================

clean_immune_axis_limits <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(
      c(
        bottom = -1,
        top = 1
      )
    )
  }

  data_range <- range(x)

  if (diff(data_range) == 0) {

    padding <- max(
      abs(data_range),
      1
    ) * 0.10

  } else {

    padding <- diff(
      data_range
    ) * 0.08
  }

  clean_breaks <- pretty(
    c(
      data_range[1] - padding,
      data_range[2] + padding
    ),
    n = 4
  )

  c(
    bottom = min(clean_breaks),
    top = max(clean_breaks)
  )
}

immune_axis_limits_cnv <- immune_sample_plot_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_immune_score)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Immune_program,
    facet_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    axis_limits = list(
      clean_immune_axis_limits(
        mean_immune_score
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_axis_bottom = vapply(
      axis_limits,
      function(x) x[["bottom"]],
      numeric(1)
    ),

    y_axis_top = vapply(
      axis_limits,
      function(x) x[["top"]],
      numeric(1)
    ),

    facet_label = factor(
      facet_label,
      levels = facet_order_immune_cnv
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -axis_limits
  )

# Invisible anchor points force the intended axis range
immune_axis_anchor_data_cnv <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  immune_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(

      collagen_group = factor(

        levels = c(
          "COL_Low",
          "COL_High"
        )
      ),
      axis_value = y_axis_bottom
    ),

  immune_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Immune_program,
      facet_label,
      collagen_group = factor(
        "COL_Low",
        levels = c(
          "COL_Low",
          "COL_High"
        )
      ),
      axis_value = y_axis_top
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Combined plot containing all immune programs
# ============================================================

p_all_immune_paired_cnv <- ggplot(
  immune_sample_plot_cnv,
  aes(
    x = collagen_group,
    y = mean_immune_score
  )
) +

  geom_blank(
    data = immune_axis_anchor_data_cnv,
    aes(
      x = collagen_group,
      y = axis_value
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # Standardized score of zero
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  # Pair COL_Low and COL_High from the same tumor
  geom_line(
    data = paired_immune_plot_data_cnv,
    aes(
      group = sample
    ),
    color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # Show all available tumor-level values
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = collagen_group
    ),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.035,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Means calculated using paired tumors only
  stat_summary(
    data = paired_immune_plot_data_cnv,
    aes(
      group = collagen_group
    ),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
      "COL_High" = "firebrick"
    )
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ facet_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 4
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = function(limits) {
      sort(
        unique(
          c(
            pretty(
              limits,
              n = 4
            ),
            limits[1],
            limits[2]
          )
        )
      )
    },

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Immune marker-program scores in CNV-filtered GBM regions",

    subtitle = paste0(
      "CT and IT regions only; each point represents one tumor; ",
      "black diamonds show means from paired tumors"
    ),

    x = NULL,

  ) +

    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )

print(
  p_all_immune_paired_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Save combined 4 × 4 plot
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    immune_analysis_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "All_ImmuneScores_CNVFiltered_",

# ============================================================
# 12. Save one separate plot per immune program

for (program_i in immune_programs_to_plot_cnv) {

  ggsave(

}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Paired analysis of TGF-beta-related genes
# CNV-filtered CT/IT regions only
#
# Each point = one tumor-level mean expression value
# Gray lines = paired COL_Low and COL_High values
# Black diamonds = paired-tumor group means
#
# Statistical test:
#   Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test
#
# Multiple testing:
#   1. BH FDR across all non-collagen TGF-beta genes
#   2. BH FDR within each TGF-beta gene category
#
# IMPORTANT:
# COL1A1, COL1A2, and COL3A1 defined the collagen groups.
# Their comparisons are descriptive sanity checks only.
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

tgfb_analysis_out_dir <- file.path(
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered",
  "TGFB_Gene_Paired_Analysis"
)

tgfb_individual_plot_dir <- file.path(
  tgfb_analysis_out_dir,
  "Individual_Plots"
)

if (!dir.exists(tgfb_analysis_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    tgfb_analysis_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

if (!dir.exists(tgfb_individual_plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    tgfb_individual_plot_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Define TGF-beta-related gene categories
#
# SMAD8 is represented by SMAD9.
# CTGF is represented by CCN2.
# ============================================================

tgfb_gene_sets_cnv <- list(

  Ligands = c(
    "TGFB1",
    "TGFB2",
    "TGFB3"
  ),

  Receptors = c(
    "TGFBR1",
    "TGFBR2",
    "TGFBR3"
  ),

  SMADs = c(
    "SMAD1",
    "SMAD2",
    "SMAD3",
    "SMAD4",
    "SMAD5",
    "SMAD6",
    "SMAD7",
    "SMAD9"
  ),

  Targets = c(
    "COL1A1",
    "COL1A2",
    "COL3A1",
    "COL4A1",
    "COL5A1",
    "FN1",
    "ACTA2",
    "SERPINE1",
    "TIMP1",
    "MMP2",
    "MMP9",
    "PLOD2",
    "LOX",
    "LOXL2",
    "VIM",
    "SNAI1",
    "SNAI2",
    "TWIST1",
    "ZEB1",
    "ZEB2",
    "CDH2",
    "VEGFA",
    "PDGFB",
    "IL11",
    "IL6",
    "CCN2",
    "CDKN1A",
    "CDKN2B",
    "MYC",
    "JUNB",
    "ATF3",
    "SKIL",
    "BAMBI",
    "LTBP1",
    "THBS1",
    "COMP"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Identify available and missing genes
# ============================================================

all_tgfb_genes_requested_cnv <- unique(
  unlist(
    tgfb_gene_sets_cnv,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)

available_tgfb_genes_cnv <- intersect(
  all_tgfb_genes_requested_cnv,
  colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)

missing_tgfb_genes_cnv <- setdiff(
  all_tgfb_genes_requested_cnv,
  colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)

cat(
  "TGF-beta genes requested:",
  length(all_tgfb_genes_requested_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "TGF-beta genes available:",
  length(available_tgfb_genes_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "TGF-beta genes missing:",
  length(missing_tgfb_genes_cnv),
  "\n"
)

if (length(missing_tgfb_genes_cnv) > 0) {
  print(missing_tgfb_genes_cnv)
}

stopifnot(
  length(available_tgfb_genes_cnv) > 0
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Create gene-category annotation table
# ============================================================

tgfb_gene_annotation_cnv <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(tgfb_gene_sets_cnv),
    function(category_i) {

      data.frame(
        Gene = tgfb_gene_sets_cnv[[category_i]],
        Category = category_i,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Gene %in% available_tgfb_genes_cnv
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Gene,
    Category
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_group_definition_gene = Gene %in% c(
      "COL1A1",
      "COL1A2",
      "COL3A1"
    )
  )

tgfb_gene_annotation_cnv


# ============================================================
# 4. Convert TGF-beta gene expression to long format
#
# All CT/IT dots are retained, including zero-expression dots.
# ============================================================

tgfb_expression_long_cnv <- gene_expr_gbm_cnv %>%
  dplyr::select(
    barcode,
    sample,
    AF_CNV,
    collagen_group,
    collagen_score,
    dplyr::all_of(
      available_tgfb_genes_cnv
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      available_tgfb_genes_cnv
    ),
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tgfb_gene_annotation_cnv,
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    ),

    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c(
        "Ligands",
        "Receptors",
        "SMADs",
        "Targets"
      )
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  all(
    tgfb_expression_long_cnv$AF_CNV %in%
      c("CT", "IT")
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Calculate tumor-level mean expression
#
# One value for each:
# Gene × tumor × collagen group
# ============================================================

sample_order_tgfb_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    tgfb_expression_long_cnv$sample
  )
)

tgfb_sample_summary_cnv <- tgfb_expression_long_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),
    Category = as.character(Category),
    collagen_group = as.character(collagen_group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    Category,
    is_group_definition_gene,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    mean_expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    percent_detected = 100 * mean(
      Expression > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    tidyr::nesting(
      Gene,
      Category,
      is_group_definition_gene
    ),

    sample = sample_order_tgfb_cnv,

    collagen_group = c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    ),

    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_expression = NA_real_,
      percent_detected = NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Put COL_Low and COL_High values side by side
# ============================================================

tgfb_sample_pairs_cnv <- tgfb_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = collagen_group,

    values_from = c(
      n_dots,
      mean_expression,
      percent_detected
    ),

    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_pair =
      !is.na(mean_expression__COL_Low) &
      !is.na(mean_expression__COL_High),

    expression_difference = dplyr::if_else(
      has_pair,

      mean_expression__COL_High -
        mean_expression__COL_Low,

      NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Safe paired Wilcoxon-test function
# ============================================================

paired_wilcox_tgfb_cnv <- function(low, high) {

  keep <- stats::complete.cases(
    low,
    high
  )

  low <- low[keep]
  high <- high[keep]

  if (length(low) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  differences <- high - low

  if (all(differences == 0)) {
    return(1)
  }

  suppressWarnings(
    stats::wilcox.test(
      x = high,
      y = low,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 8. Run paired tests for every available gene
# ============================================================

tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv <- tgfb_sample_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    Category,
    is_group_definition_gene
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total_samples = dplyr::n(),

    n_paired_samples = sum(
      has_pair
    ),

    mean_COL_Low = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_expression__COL_Low[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_COL_High = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        mean_expression__COL_High[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_difference = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      mean(
        expression_difference[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    median_difference = if (
      sum(has_pair) > 0
    ) {
      median(
        expression_difference[has_pair],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    tumors_higher_in_COL_High = sum(
      expression_difference > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_higher_in_COL_Low = sum(
      expression_difference < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    tumors_with_no_difference = sum(
      expression_difference == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    p_value = paired_wilcox_tgfb_cnv(
      mean_expression__COL_Low,
      mean_expression__COL_High
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. Multiple-testing correction
#
# Collagen group-definition genes are excluded from FDR.
# ============================================================

# FDR across all independently tested TGF-beta genes
nondefining_gene_indices <- which(
  !tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv$is_group_definition_gene
)

tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv$FDR_all_TGFB <- NA_real_

tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv$FDR_all_TGFB[
  nondefining_gene_indices
] <- stats::p.adjust(
  tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv$p_value[
    nondefining_gene_indices
  ],
  method = "BH"
)


# FDR separately within each biological category
tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv <- tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Category
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_within_category = {

      adjusted_values <- rep(
        NA_real_,
        dplyr::n()
      )

      valid_indices <- which(
        !is_group_definition_gene &
          !is.na(p_value)
      )

      adjusted_values[
        valid_indices
      ] <- stats::p.adjust(
        p_value[
          valid_indices
        ],
        method = "BH"
      )

      adjusted_values
    }
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    is_group_definition_gene,
    FDR_all_TGFB,
    p_value
  )

tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv


# ============================================================
# 10. Create statistical labels
# ============================================================

tgfb_stat_labels_cnv <- tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~
        "p = NA",

      p_value < 0.001 ~
        "p < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "p = ",
        formatC(
          p_value,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    fdr_label = dplyr::case_when(
      is_group_definition_gene ~
        "descriptive only",

      is.na(FDR_all_TGFB) ~
        "FDR = NA",

      FDR_all_TGFB < 0.001 ~
        "FDR < 0.001",

      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "FDR = ",
        formatC(
          FDR_all_TGFB,
          format = "f",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    ),

    facet_label = paste0(
      Gene,
      "\n",
      p_label,
      "; ",
      fdr_label,
      "\npaired n = ",
      n_paired_samples
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    Category,
    facet_label
  )


# ============================================================
# 11. Prepare plotting data
# ============================================================

tgfb_sample_plot_cnv <- tgfb_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tgfb_stat_labels_cnv,
    by = c(
      "Gene",
      "Category"
    )
  )

paired_tgfb_sample_ids_cnv <- tgfb_sample_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    has_pair
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    sample
  )

paired_tgfb_plot_data_cnv <- tgfb_sample_plot_cnv %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    paired_tgfb_sample_ids_cnv,
    by = c(
      "Gene",
      "sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_expression)
  )


# ============================================================
# 12. Clean gene-specific y-axis limits
#
# Expression values are nonnegative, so every panel begins at 0.
# ============================================================

clean_tgfb_axis_top <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0 || max(x) <= 0) {
    return(1)
  }

  max(
    pretty(
      c(
        0,
        max(x) * 1.08
      ),
      n = 4
    )
  )
}

tgfb_axis_limits_cnv <- tgfb_sample_plot_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_expression)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    Category,
    facet_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    y_axis_top = clean_tgfb_axis_top(
      mean_expression
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tgfb_axis_anchor_data_cnv <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  tgfb_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene,
      Category,
      facet_label,
      collagen_group = factor(
        "COL_Low",
        levels = c(
          "COL_Low",
          "COL_High"
        )
      ),
      axis_value = 0
    ),

  tgfb_axis_limits_cnv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene,
      Category,
      facet_label,
      collagen_group = factor(
        "COL_Low",
        levels = c(
          "COL_Low",
          "COL_High"
        )
      ),
      axis_value = y_axis_top
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Function to create one category-level paired plot
# ============================================================

plot_tgfb_category_cnv <- function(category_i) {

  category_plot_data <- tgfb_sample_plot_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Category == category_i
    )

  category_paired_data <- paired_tgfb_plot_data_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Category == category_i
    )

  category_axis_data <- tgfb_axis_anchor_data_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Category == category_i
    )

  gene_order <- tgfb_gene_sets_cnv[[category_i]]

  gene_order <- gene_order[
    gene_order %in%
      category_plot_data$Gene
  ]

  category_facet_order <- tgfb_stat_labels_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Category == category_i
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice(
      match(
        gene_order,
        Gene
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      facet_label
    )

  category_plot_data$facet_label <- factor(
    category_plot_data$facet_label,
    levels = category_facet_order
  )

  category_paired_data$facet_label <- factor(
    category_paired_data$facet_label,
    levels = category_facet_order
  )

  category_axis_data$facet_label <- factor(
    category_axis_data$facet_label,
    levels = category_facet_order
  )

  p_category <- ggplot(
    category_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = collagen_group,
      y = mean_expression
    )
  ) +

    geom_blank(
      data = category_axis_data,
      aes(
        x = collagen_group,
        y = axis_value
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = category_paired_data,
      aes(
        group = sample
      ),
      color = "grey65",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = collagen_group
      ),
      position = position_jitter(
        width = 0.035,
        height = 0,
        seed = 123
      ),
      size = 2.2,
      alpha = 0.9,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      data = category_paired_data,
      aes(
        group = collagen_group
      ),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 18,
      size = 4,
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
        "COL_High" = "firebrick"
      )
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~ facet_label,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 4
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = function(limits) {
        sort(
          unique(
            c(
              pretty(
                limits,
                n = 4
              ),
              limits[1],
              limits[2]
            )
          )
        )
      },

      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0)
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "TGF-beta ",
        category_i,
        " in CNV-filtered GBM regions"
      ),

      subtitle = paste0(
        "CT and IT regions only; each point represents one tumor; ",
        "black diamonds show paired-tumor means"
      ),

      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean processed expression",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "top",

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        face = "bold",
        size = 8
      ),

      strip.background = element_blank(),

      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 8
      ),

      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
        0.5,
        "cm"
      ),

      panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(
        0.7,
        "cm"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 9
      )
    )

  return(
    p_category
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 14. Create and save category-level plots
# ============================================================

for (category_i in names(tgfb_gene_sets_cnv)) {

  p_category_i <- plot_tgfb_category_cnv(
    category_i
  )

  print(
    p_category_i
  )

  n_category_genes <- sum(
    tgfb_gene_annotation_cnv$Category ==
      category_i
  )

  plot_height <- max(
    4,
    ceiling(
      n_category_genes / 4
    ) * 3.5
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      tgfb_analysis_out_dir,
      paste0(
        "TGFB_",
        category_i,
        "_COLLow_vs_COLHigh_Paired.pdf"
      )
    ),

    plot = p_category_i,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 12,
    height = plot_height,
    units = "in"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 15. Save one individual plot per gene
# ============================================================

for (gene_i in available_tgfb_genes_cnv) {

  gene_plot_data <- tgfb_sample_plot_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i
    )

  gene_paired_data <- paired_tgfb_plot_data_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i
    )

  gene_axis_data <- tgfb_axis_anchor_data_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i
    )

  gene_stats <- tgfb_paired_statistics_cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Gene == gene_i
    )

  p_text <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(gene_stats$p_value) ~
      "Paired Wilcoxon p = NA",

    gene_stats$p_value < 0.001 ~
      "Paired Wilcoxon p < 0.001",

    TRUE ~ paste0(
      "Paired Wilcoxon p = ",
      formatC(
        gene_stats$p_value,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    )
  )

  fdr_text <- dplyr::case_when(
    gene_stats$is_group_definition_gene ~
      "Descriptive only: collagen group-defining gene",

    is.na(gene_stats$FDR_all_TGFB) ~
      "FDR = NA",

    gene_stats$FDR_all_TGFB < 0.001 ~
      "FDR < 0.001",

    TRUE ~ paste0(
      "FDR = ",
      formatC(
        gene_stats$FDR_all_TGFB,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    )
  )

  p_gene <- ggplot(
    gene_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = collagen_group,
      y = mean_expression
    )
  ) +

    geom_blank(
      data = gene_axis_data,
      aes(
        x = collagen_group,
        y = axis_value
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = gene_paired_data,
      aes(
        group = sample
      ),
      color = "grey65",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = collagen_group
      ),
      position = position_jitter(
        width = 0.035,
        height = 0,
        seed = 123
      ),
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.9,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      data = gene_paired_data,
      aes(
        group = collagen_group
      ),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 18,
      size = 4.5,
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
        "COL_High" = "firebrick"
      )
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = function(limits) {
        sort(
          unique(
            c(
              pretty(
                limits,
                n = 4
              ),
              limits[1],
              limits[2]
            )
          )
        )
      },

      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0)
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = gene_i,

      subtitle = paste0(
        p_text,
        "\n",
        fdr_text,
        "\nPaired tumors = ",
        gene_stats$n_paired_samples
      ),

      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean processed expression",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 8
      )
    )

  print(
    p_gene
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      tgfb_individual_plot_dir,
      paste0(
        "TGFB_",
        gene_i,
        "_COLLow_vs_COLHigh_Paired.pdf"
      )
    ),

    plot = p_gene,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 3,
    height = 4.2,
    units = "in"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 16. Save all underlying values and statistics
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  tgfb_sample_summary_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    tgfb_analysis_out_dir,
    "TGFB_Genes_SampleLevel_Means.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  tgfb_sample_pairs_cnv,
  file = file.path(

write.csv(

write.csv(
  tgfb_gene_annotation_cnv,
  file = file.path(

    "TGFB_Gene_Categories.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
