```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered TGF-beta blocked heatmap
#
# Left block:  COL_Low CT/IT regions
# Right block: COL_High CT/IT regions
#
# Each tile = mean gene expression within one tumor and
# collagen category.
#
# Color = gene-wise z-score of sample-level mean expression.
# Gray = that tumor had no dots in that collagen category.
# ============================================================


tgfb_heatmap_out_dir <-
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered/Heatmaps"

if (!dir.exists(tgfb_heatmap_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    tgfb_heatmap_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Define TGF-beta genes
# ============================================================

tgfb_gene_sets_cnv <- list(

  Ligands = c(
    "TGFB1",
    "TGFB2",
    "TGFB3"
  ),

  Receptors = c(
    "TGFBR1",
    "TGFBR2",
    "TGFBR3"
  ),

  SMADs = c(
    "SMAD1",
    "SMAD2",
    "SMAD3",
    "SMAD4",
    "SMAD5",
    "SMAD6",
    "SMAD7",
    "SMAD9"
  ),

  Targets = c(
    "COL1A1",
    "COL1A2",
    "COL3A1",
    "COL4A1",
    "COL5A1",
    "FN1",
    "ACTA2",
    "SERPINE1",
    "TIMP1",
    "MMP2",
    "MMP9",
    "PLOD2",
    "LOX",
    "LOXL2",
    "VIM",
    "SNAI1",
    "SNAI2",
    "TWIST1",
    "ZEB1",
    "ZEB2",
    "CDH2",
    "VEGFA",
    "PDGFB",
    "IL11",
    "IL6",
    "CCN2",
    "CDKN1A",
    "CDKN2B",
    "MYC",
    "JUNB",
    "ATF3",
    "SKIL",
    "BAMBI",
    "LTBP1",
    "THBS1",
    "COMP"
  )
)


# Create one ordered, nonduplicated gene vector
genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv <- unique(
  unlist(
    tgfb_gene_sets_cnv,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check gene availability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_tgfb_genes_cnv <- setdiff(
  genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv,
  colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)

if (length(missing_tgfb_genes_cnv) > 0) {

  message(
    "Missing TGF-beta genes omitted from heatmap: ",
    paste(
      missing_tgfb_genes_cnv,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# Retain requested order while removing unavailable genes
genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv <- genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv[
  genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv %in%
    colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
]

stopifnot(
  length(genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv) > 0
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Convert TGF-beta genes to long format
# ============================================================

gene_expression_long_tgfb_cnv <- gene_expr_gbm_cnv %>%
  dplyr::select(
    barcode,
    sample,
    AF_CNV,
    collagen_group,
    collagen_score,
    dplyr::all_of(
      genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    AF_CNV %in% c(
      "CT",
      "IT"
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv
    ),
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    ),

    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels = genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Set sample and group order
# ============================================================

sample_order_tgfb_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    gene_expression_long_tgfb_cnv$sample
  )
)

collagen_group_order_tgfb_cnv <- c(
  "COL_Low",
  "COL_High"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Calculate sample-level mean expression
#
# All CT/IT dots are included, including gene-expression zeros.
# ============================================================

gene_sample_summary_tgfb_cnv <-
  gene_expression_long_tgfb_cnv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),
    collagen_group = as.character(
      collagen_group
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    mean_expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    percent_detected = 100 * mean(
      Expression > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Add missing sample/category combinations
#
# Missing collagen category:
#   n_dots = 0
#   mean expression = NA
# ============================================================

gene_sample_summary_tgfb_cnv_complete <-
  gene_sample_summary_tgfb_cnv %>%
  tidyr::complete(

    Gene = genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv,

    sample = sample_order_tgfb_cnv,

    collagen_group =
      collagen_group_order_tgfb_cnv,

    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_expression = NA_real_,
      percent_detected = NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Calculate gene-wise z-scores
#
# Z-scores are only used for heatmap visualization.
# Raw mean_expression values remain available for statistics.
# ============================================================

gene_sample_heatmap_tgfb_cnv <-
  gene_sample_summary_tgfb_cnv_complete %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    gene_mean = mean(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    gene_sd = stats::sd(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_expression_z = dplyr::case_when(

      is.na(mean_expression) ~
        NA_real_,

      !is.finite(gene_mean) ~
        0,

      is.na(gene_sd) ~
        0,

      gene_sd == 0 ~
        0,

      TRUE ~
        (
          mean_expression -
            gene_mean
        ) /
        gene_sd
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order_tgfb_cnv
    ),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels =
        collagen_group_order_tgfb_cnv
    ),

    # Reversing the factor places TGFB ligands
    # at the top of the heatmap.
    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels = rev(
        genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Create blocked TGF-beta heatmap
# ============================================================

p_gene_heatmap_tgfb_cnv <- ggplot(
  gene_sample_heatmap_tgfb_cnv,
  aes(
    x = sample,
    y = Gene,
    fill = mean_expression_z
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(
      collagen_group
    ),
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "steelblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(
      -2,
      2
    ),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "grey75",
    name = paste0(
      "Mean expression\n",
      "z-score"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "TGF-beta pathway expression in ",
      "CNV-filtered GBM regions"
    ),

    subtitle = paste0(
      "CT and IT dots only; gray indicates no dots ",
      "in that tumor category"
    ),

    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 8
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey92",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.35,
      "cm"
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )
  )


print(
  p_gene_heatmap_tgfb_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 8. Save heatmap
# ============================================================

tgfb_heatmap_height_cnv <- max(
  6,
  0.22 *
    length(
      genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv
    ) +
    2
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    tgfb_heatmap_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "TGFbGeneExpression_CNVFiltered_",
      "COLLow_COLHigh_Heatmap.pdf"
    )
  ),
  plot = p_gene_heatmap_tgfb_cnv,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 9,
  height = tgfb_heatmap_height_cnv,
  units = "in"
)


# ============================================================
# 9. Save underlying raw and z-scored values
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  gene_sample_heatmap_tgfb_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    tgfb_heatmap_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "TGFbGeneExpression_CNVFiltered_",
      "Heatmap_Data.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Inspect final results
# ============================================================

dim(
  gene_sample_heatmap_tgfb_cnv
)

genes_to_plot_tgfb_cnv

missing_tgfb_genes_cnv
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered TGF-beta target score
#
# Score:
#   Mean gene-wise z-score across TGF-beta target genes
#   for each CT/IT dot.
#
# Statistical unit:
#   One tumor-level mean score per collagen category.
#
# Test:
#   Paired Wilcoxon test comparing COL_Low vs COL_High.
#
# Important:
#   COL1A1, COL1A2, and COL3A1 are excluded because they
#   were used to define COL_Low and COL_High.
# ============================================================


tgfb_score_out_dir <-
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered/TGFb_Target_Score"

if (!dir.exists(tgfb_score_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    tgfb_score_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Define genes used in the TGF-beta target score
# ============================================================

collagen_grouping_genes_cnv <- c(
  "COL1A1",
  "COL1A2",
  "COL3A1"
)


tgfb_target_score_genes_requested_cnv <- setdiff(
  tgfb_gene_sets_cnv$Targets,
  collagen_grouping_genes_cnv
)


missing_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv <- setdiff(
  tgfb_target_score_genes_requested_cnv,
  colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)


available_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv <-
  tgfb_target_score_genes_requested_cnv[
    tgfb_target_score_genes_requested_cnv %in%
      colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
  ]


if (length(missing_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv) > 0) {

  message(
    "Missing TGF-beta target genes omitted from score: ",
    paste(
      missing_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


stopifnot(
  length(available_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv) >= 2
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Subset to CT/IT dots with a valid collagen category
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_score_data_cnv <- gene_expr_gbm_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    AF_CNV %in% c(
      "CT",
      "IT"
    ),
    collagen_group %in% c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  )


stopifnot(
  nrow(tgfb_target_score_data_cnv) > 0
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Create target-gene expression matrix
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv <- as.matrix(
  tgfb_target_score_data_cnv[
    ,
    available_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


storage.mode(
  tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv
) <- "numeric"


# ============================================================
# 4. Remove genes with no expression variance
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_gene_sds_cnv <- apply(
  tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  FUN = stats::sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


zero_variance_tgfb_genes_cnv <- names(
  tgfb_target_gene_sds_cnv
)[
  !is.finite(tgfb_target_gene_sds_cnv) |
    tgfb_target_gene_sds_cnv == 0
]


if (length(zero_variance_tgfb_genes_cnv) > 0) {

  message(
    "Zero-variance genes omitted from score: ",
    paste(
      zero_variance_tgfb_genes_cnv,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


tgfb_target_score_genes_used_cnv <- setdiff(
  available_tgfb_target_score_genes_cnv,
  zero_variance_tgfb_genes_cnv
)


stopifnot(
  length(tgfb_target_score_genes_used_cnv) >= 2
)


tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv <-
  tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv[
    ,
    tgfb_target_score_genes_used_cnv,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


# ============================================================
# 5. Calculate gene-wise z-scores across CT/IT dots
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_gene_means_cnv <- colMeans(
  tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


tgfb_target_gene_sds_cnv <- apply(
  tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  FUN = stats::sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


tgfb_target_z_matrix_cnv <- sweep(
  tgfb_target_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = tgfb_target_gene_means_cnv,
  FUN = "-"
)


tgfb_target_z_matrix_cnv <- sweep(
  tgfb_target_z_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = tgfb_target_gene_sds_cnv,
  FUN = "/"
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Calculate one TGF-beta target score per dot
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_score_data_cnv$TGFb_Target_Score <- rowMeans(
  tgfb_target_z_matrix_cnv,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


tgfb_target_score_data_cnv$TGFb_Target_Score[
  !is.finite(
    tgfb_target_score_data_cnv$TGFb_Target_Score
  )
] <- NA_real_


summary(
  tgfb_target_score_data_cnv$TGFb_Target_Score
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Calculate tumor-level mean scores
# ============================================================

sample_order_tgfb_score_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    tgfb_target_score_data_cnv$sample
  )
)


tgfb_target_sample_summary_cnv <-
  tgfb_target_score_data_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_dots = sum(
      !is.na(TGFb_Target_Score)
    ),

    mean_target_score = mean(
      TGFb_Target_Score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_target_score = median(
      TGFb_Target_Score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = as.character(
      collagen_group
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(

    sample = sample_order_tgfb_score_cnv,

    collagen_group = c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    ),

    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_target_score = NA_real_,
      median_target_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order_tgfb_score_cnv
    ),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. Put paired scores side by side
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_score_pairs_cnv <-
  tgfb_target_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(

    names_from = collagen_group,

    values_from = c(
      n_dots,
      mean_target_score,
      median_target_score
    ),

    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    has_pair =
      !is.na(mean_target_score__COL_Low) &
      !is.na(mean_target_score__COL_High),

    score_difference =
      mean_target_score__COL_High -
      mean_target_score__COL_Low
  )


tgfb_target_score_pairs_cnv


# ============================================================
# 9. Run paired Wilcoxon test
# ============================================================

paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv <-
  tgfb_target_score_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    has_pair
  )


n_paired_tgfb_score_cnv <- nrow(
  paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv
)


if (n_paired_tgfb_score_cnv < 2) {

  tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv <- NA_real_

} else if (
  all(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$score_difference == 0
  )
) {

  tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv <- 1

} else {

  tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv <- suppressWarnings(
    stats::wilcox.test(

      x =
        paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
          mean_target_score__COL_High,

      y =
        paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
          mean_target_score__COL_Low,

      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
  )
}


tgfb_target_score_statistics_cnv <- tibble::tibble(

  n_total_samples =
    nrow(tgfb_target_score_pairs_cnv),

  n_paired_samples =
    n_paired_tgfb_score_cnv,

  n_score_genes =
    length(tgfb_target_score_genes_used_cnv),

  mean_COL_Low = mean(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      mean_target_score__COL_Low,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  mean_COL_High = mean(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      mean_target_score__COL_High,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  mean_difference = mean(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      score_difference,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  median_difference = median(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      score_difference,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  tumors_higher_in_COL_High = sum(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      score_difference > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  tumors_higher_in_COL_Low = sum(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      score_difference < 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  tumors_with_no_difference = sum(
    paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv$
      score_difference == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  p_value =
    tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv
)


tgfb_target_score_statistics_cnv


# ============================================================
# 10. Create statistical label
# ============================================================

tgfb_target_score_p_label_cnv <- dplyr::case_when(

  is.na(tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv) ~
    "p = NA",

  tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv < 0.001 ~
    "p < 0.001",

  TRUE ~ paste0(
    "p = ",
    formatC(
      tgfb_target_score_p_value_cnv,
      format = "f",
      digits = 3
    )
  )
)


tgfb_target_score_subtitle_cnv <- paste0(

  "CT and IT regions only; paired Wilcoxon test; ",

  tgfb_target_score_p_label_cnv,

  "; paired n = ",
  n_paired_tgfb_score_cnv,

  "; score genes = ",
  length(tgfb_target_score_genes_used_cnv)
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Prepare paired plotting data
# ============================================================

paired_tgfb_sample_ids_cnv <-
  paired_tgfb_target_scores_cnv %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample
  )


paired_tgfb_target_plot_data_cnv <-
  tgfb_target_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    paired_tgfb_sample_ids_cnv,
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_target_score)
  )


# ============================================================
# 12. Calculate clean y-axis limits and breaks
# ============================================================

tgfb_score_range_cnv <- range(
  tgfb_target_sample_summary_cnv$mean_target_score,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


tgfb_score_breaks_cnv <- pretty(
  tgfb_score_range_cnv,
  n = 5
)


tgfb_score_y_min_cnv <- min(
  tgfb_score_breaks_cnv
)


tgfb_score_y_max_cnv <- max(
  tgfb_score_breaks_cnv
)


tgfb_score_breaks_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    c(
      tgfb_score_breaks_cnv,
      tgfb_score_y_min_cnv,
      tgfb_score_y_max_cnv
    )
  )
)


tgfb_score_breaks_cnv <- tgfb_score_breaks_cnv[
  tgfb_score_breaks_cnv >= tgfb_score_y_min_cnv &
    tgfb_score_breaks_cnv <= tgfb_score_y_max_cnv
]


# ============================================================
# 13. Create paired TGF-beta target-score plot
# ============================================================

p_tgfb_target_score_cnv <- ggplot(
  tgfb_target_sample_summary_cnv,
  aes(
    x = collagen_group,
    y = mean_target_score
  )
) +

  # Connect the two collagen categories from each paired tumor
  geom_line(
    data = paired_tgfb_target_plot_data_cnv,
    aes(
      group = sample
    ),
    color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # Show tumor-level mean scores
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = collagen_group
    ),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.035,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Black diamonds show means from paired tumors only
  stat_summary(
    data = paired_tgfb_target_plot_data_cnv,
    aes(
      group = collagen_group
    ),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
      "COL_High" = "firebrick"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      tgfb_score_y_min_cnv,
      tgfb_score_y_max_cnv
    ),
    breaks = tgfb_score_breaks_cnv,
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "TGF-beta target-expression score",
    subtitle = tgfb_target_score_subtitle_cnv,
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean TGF-beta target score",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 14
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )
  )


print(
  p_tgfb_target_score_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Save paired score plot
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    tgfb_score_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "TGFbTargetScore_CNVFiltered_",
      "COLLow_vs_COLHigh_Paired.pdf"
    )
  ),
  plot = p_tgfb_target_score_cnv,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 4,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in"
)


# ============================================================
# 15. Save score results
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  tgfb_target_sample_summary_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    tgfb_score_out_dir,
    "TGFbTargetScore_SampleLevel_Values.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  tgfb_target_score_pairs_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    tgfb_score_out_dir,
    "TGFbTargetScore_Paired_Values.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  tgfb_target_score_statistics_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    tgfb_score_out_dir,
    "TGFbTargetScore_Paired_Statistics.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  tibble::tibble(
    Gene = tgfb_target_score_genes_used_cnv
  ),
  file = file.path(
    tgfb_score_out_dir,
    "TGFbTargetScore_Genes_Used.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered Reactome PD-1 co-inhibition score
#
# Pathway:
#   REACTOME_CO_INHIBITION_BY_PD_1
#   Reactome R-HSA-389948
#
# Score:
#   Mean gene-wise z-score across available Reactome PD-1
#   pathway genes for each CT/IT dot.
#
# Statistical unit:
#   One tumor-level mean score per collagen category.
#
# Test:
#   Paired Wilcoxon test comparing COL_Low vs COL_High.
#
# Interpretation:
#   Higher score = greater expression of the transcriptional
#   program represented by the Reactome PD-1 co-inhibition
#   pathway.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   This is a pathway-expression/module score.
#   It should not be described as a direct biochemical
#   measurement of PD-1 receptor activation.
# ============================================================


pd1_reactome_out_dir <-
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered/PD1_Reactome_Score"

if (!dir.exists(pd1_reactome_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Define Reactome PD-1 pathway genes
#
# MSigDB:
#   REACTOME_CO_INHIBITION_BY_PD_1
#
# Reactome:
#   R-HSA-389948
#
# Current MSigDB set contains 224 genes.
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_gene_text_cnv <- paste(
  c(

    "ADRM1 AGO1 AGO2 AGO3 AGO4 ASH2L ATF3 B3GNT3 BRD4 BTRC CCND1 CD247 CD274 CD3D CD3E CD3G CD4 CDK4 COPS5 CREBBP",

    "CSK CSNK2A1 CSNK2A2 CSNK2B CTNNB1 CUL1 CUL3 DAD1 DDOST DERL1 DERL2 DERL3 DPY30 EED EP300 EPAS1 ERLEC1 ERLIN1 ERLIN2 EZH2",

    "FOS FOSB GSK3B H2AB1 H2AC14 H2AC18 H2AC19 H2AC20 H2AC4 H2AC6 H2AC7 H2AC8 H2AJ H2AX H2AZ2 H2BC1 H2BC10 H2BC11 H2BC12 H2BC12L",

    "H2BC13 H2BC14 H2BC15 H2BC17 H2BC21 H2BC26 H2BC3 H2BC4 H2BC5 H2BC6 H2BC7 H2BC8 H2BC9 H3-3A H3-3B H3C1 H3C10 H3C11 H3C12 H3C13",

    "H3C14 H3C15 H3C2 H3C3 H3C4 H3C6 H3C7 H3C8 H4C1 H4C11 H4C12 H4C13 H4C14 H4C15 H4C16 H4C2 H4C3 H4C4 H4C5 H4C6",

    "H4C8 H4C9 HIF1A HLA-DPA1 HLA-DPB1 HLA-DQA1 HLA-DQA2 HLA-DQB1 HLA-DQB2 HLA-DRA HLA-DRB1 HLA-DRB3 HLA-DRB4 HLA-DRB5 IRF1 JAK1 JUN JUND KMT2A KMT2C",

    "LCK LEF1 MAGT1 MIB2 MIR200B MIR200C MIR34B MIR34C MIRLET7A1 MOV10 MYC MYCN NEK2 NFE2L2 NFKB1 NFKB2 OS9 OST4 OSTC PDCD1",

    "PDCD1LG2 PRKAA1 PRKAA2 PRKAB1 PRKAB2 PRKAG1 PRKAG2 PRKAG3 PSMA1 PSMA2 PSMA3 PSMA4 PSMA5 PSMA6 PSMA7 PSMB1 PSMB2 PSMB3 PSMB4 PSMB5",

    "PSMB6 PSMB7 PSMC1 PSMC2 PSMC3 PSMC4 PSMC5 PSMC6 PSMD1 PSMD11 PSMD12 PSMD13 PSMD14 PSMD2 PSMD3 PSMD6 PSMD7 PSMD8 PTPN11 PTPN6",

    "RBBP4 RBBP5 RBBP7 RBX1 RELA RNF185 RNF5 RPN1 RPN2 RPS27A SEL1L SEM1 SKP1 SPOP STAT1 STAT3 STT3A STT3B SUZ12 TCF7",

    "TCF7L1 TCF7L2 TEAD1 TEAD2 TEAD3 TEAD4 TMEM258 TNRC6A TNRC6B TNRC6C TRAV19 TRAV29DV5 TRAV8-4 TRBV12-3 TRBV7-9 TUSC3 UBA52 UBB UBC VCP",

    "WDR5 WWTR1 YAP1 YWHAG"
  ),
  collapse = " "
)


pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv <- unique(
  strsplit(
    pd1_reactome_gene_text_cnv,
    split = "[[:space:]]+"
  )[[1]]
)


stopifnot(
  length(pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv) == 224
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Identify pathway genes available in our spatial dataset
# ============================================================

available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv[
    pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv %in%
      colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
  ]


missing_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv <- setdiff(
  pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv,
  colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)


cat(
  "Reactome PD-1 genes requested:",
  length(pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Reactome PD-1 genes available:",
  length(available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Reactome PD-1 genes missing:",
  length(missing_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Reactome PD-1 pathway coverage:",
  round(
    100 *
      length(available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv) /
      length(pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv),
    1
  ),
  "%\n"
)


if (length(missing_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv) > 0) {

  message(
    "Unavailable Reactome PD-1 genes omitted from score: ",
    paste(
      missing_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


stopifnot(
  length(available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv) >= 2
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Confirm key PD-1-axis genes
# ============================================================

pd1_key_genes_cnv <- c(
  "PDCD1",
  "CD274",
  "PDCD1LG2",
  "PTPN6",
  "PTPN11",
  "CD247",
  "CD3D",
  "CD3E",
  "CD3G",
  "LCK"
)


pd1_key_gene_check_cnv <- tibble::tibble(
  Gene = pd1_key_genes_cnv,
  Present = pd1_key_genes_cnv %in%
    colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)


pd1_key_gene_check_cnv


# ============================================================
# 4. Subset to CNV-filtered CT/IT dots
#
# All dots are retained, including zero-expression dots.
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv <- gene_expr_gbm_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(

    AF_CNV %in% c(
      "CT",
      "IT"
    ),

    collagen_group %in% c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  )


stopifnot(
  nrow(pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv) > 0
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Create Reactome PD-1 expression matrix
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv <- as.matrix(
  pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv[
    ,
    available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


storage.mode(
  pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv
) <- "numeric"


# ============================================================
# 6. Remove genes with no expression variance
#
# A gene with zero variance cannot be z-scored and therefore
# cannot contribute information to the pathway score.
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_gene_sds_cnv <- apply(
  pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  FUN = stats::sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


zero_variance_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv <- names(
  pd1_reactome_gene_sds_cnv
)[
  !is.finite(pd1_reactome_gene_sds_cnv) |
    pd1_reactome_gene_sds_cnv == 0
]


if (
  length(
    zero_variance_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv
  ) > 0
) {

  message(
    "Zero-variance Reactome PD-1 genes omitted: ",
    paste(
      zero_variance_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv <- setdiff(
  available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv,
  zero_variance_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv
)


stopifnot(
  length(pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv) >= 2
)


pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv[
    ,
    pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


cat(
  "Reactome PD-1 genes used in final score:",
  length(pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Calculate gene-wise z-scores across all CT/IT dots
#
# Each gene therefore contributes on the same standardized
# scale regardless of its absolute expression magnitude.
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_gene_means_cnv <- colMeans(
  pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pd1_reactome_gene_sds_cnv <- apply(
  pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  FUN = stats::sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pd1_reactome_z_matrix_cnv <- sweep(
  pd1_reactome_expression_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = pd1_reactome_gene_means_cnv,
  FUN = "-"
)


pd1_reactome_z_matrix_cnv <- sweep(
  pd1_reactome_z_matrix_cnv,
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = pd1_reactome_gene_sds_cnv,
  FUN = "/"
)


# ============================================================
# 8. Calculate one Reactome PD-1 score per spatial dot
#
# Score = mean standardized expression across pathway genes.
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv$PD1_Reactome_Score <- rowMeans(
  pd1_reactome_z_matrix_cnv,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv$PD1_Reactome_Score[
  !is.finite(
    pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv$PD1_Reactome_Score
  )
] <- NA_real_


summary(
  pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv$PD1_Reactome_Score
)


# ============================================================
# 9. Calculate tumor-level mean pathway scores
#
# Statistical unit = tumor, NOT individual spatial dot.
# ============================================================

sample_order_pd1_reactome_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv$sample
  )
)


pd1_reactome_sample_summary_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_score_data_cnv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    n_dots = sum(
      !is.na(PD1_Reactome_Score)
    ),

    mean_PD1_score = mean(
      PD1_Reactome_Score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_PD1_score = median(
      PD1_Reactome_Score,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = as.character(
      collagen_group
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(

    sample = sample_order_pd1_reactome_cnv,

    collagen_group = c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    ),

    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_PD1_score = NA_real_,
      median_PD1_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order_pd1_reactome_cnv
    ),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. Put paired COL_Low and COL_High scores side by side
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_score_pairs_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(

    names_from = collagen_group,

    values_from = c(
      n_dots,
      mean_PD1_score,
      median_PD1_score
    ),

    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    has_pair =
      !is.na(mean_PD1_score__COL_Low) &
      !is.na(mean_PD1_score__COL_High),

    score_difference =
      mean_PD1_score__COL_High -
      mean_PD1_score__COL_Low
  )


pd1_reactome_score_pairs_cnv


# ============================================================
# 11. Paired Wilcoxon test
# ============================================================

paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_score_pairs_cnv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    has_pair
  )


n_paired_pd1_reactome_cnv <- nrow(
  paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv
)


if (n_paired_pd1_reactome_cnv < 2) {

  pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv <- NA_real_

} else if (

  all(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      score_difference == 0
  )

) {

  pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv <- 1

} else {

  pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv <- suppressWarnings(
    stats::wilcox.test(

      x =
        paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
          mean_PD1_score__COL_High,

      y =
        paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
          mean_PD1_score__COL_Low,

      paired = TRUE,

      exact = FALSE,

      alternative = "two.sided"

    )$p.value
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 12. Create statistics table
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_score_statistics_cnv <- tibble::tibble(

  pathway =
    "REACTOME_CO_INHIBITION_BY_PD_1",

  reactome_id =
    "R-HSA-389948",

  n_pathway_genes_requested =
    length(
      pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv
    ),

  n_pathway_genes_available =
    length(
      available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv
    ),

  n_pathway_genes_used =
    length(
      pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv
    ),

  pathway_gene_coverage_percent =
    100 *
      length(
        available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv
      ) /
      length(
        pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv
      ),

  n_total_samples =
    nrow(
      pd1_reactome_score_pairs_cnv
    ),

  n_paired_samples =
    n_paired_pd1_reactome_cnv,

  mean_COL_Low = mean(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      mean_PD1_score__COL_Low,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  mean_COL_High = mean(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      mean_PD1_score__COL_High,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  mean_difference = mean(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      score_difference,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  median_difference = median(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      score_difference,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  tumors_higher_in_COL_High = sum(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      score_difference > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  tumors_higher_in_COL_Low = sum(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      score_difference < 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  tumors_with_no_difference = sum(
    paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv$
      score_difference == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  p_value =
    pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv
)


pd1_reactome_score_statistics_cnv


# ============================================================
# 13. Statistical label for figure
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_p_label_cnv <- dplyr::case_when(

  is.na(pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv) ~
    "p = NA",

  pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv < 0.001 ~
    "p < 0.001",

  TRUE ~ paste0(
    "p = ",
    formatC(
      pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv,
      format = "f",
      digits = 3
    )
  )
)


pd1_reactome_subtitle_cnv <- paste0(

  "CT and IT regions only; paired Wilcoxon test; ",

  pd1_reactome_p_label_cnv,

  "; paired n = ",
  n_paired_pd1_reactome_cnv,

  "; score genes = ",
  length(
    pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Prepare paired plotting data
# ============================================================

paired_pd1_sample_ids_cnv <-
  paired_pd1_reactome_scores_cnv %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample
  )


paired_pd1_reactome_plot_data_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_sample_summary_cnv %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    paired_pd1_sample_ids_cnv,
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(mean_PD1_score)
  )


# ============================================================
# 15. Calculate clean y-axis limits
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_score_range_cnv <- range(
  pd1_reactome_sample_summary_cnv$mean_PD1_score,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


stopifnot(
  all(
    is.finite(
      pd1_reactome_score_range_cnv
    )
  )
)


if (
  diff(
    pd1_reactome_score_range_cnv
  ) == 0
) {

  pd1_reactome_score_range_cnv <-
    pd1_reactome_score_range_cnv +
    c(
      -0.5,
      0.5
    )
}


pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv <- pretty(
  pd1_reactome_score_range_cnv,
  n = 5
)


pd1_reactome_y_min_cnv <- min(
  pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv
)


pd1_reactome_y_max_cnv <- max(
  pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv
)


pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv <-
  pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv[
    pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv >=
      pd1_reactome_y_min_cnv &
      pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv <=
        pd1_reactome_y_max_cnv
  ]


# ============================================================
# 16. Create paired Reactome PD-1 score plot
# ============================================================

p_pd1_reactome_score_cnv <- ggplot(
  pd1_reactome_sample_summary_cnv,
  aes(
    x = collagen_group,
    y = mean_PD1_score
  )
) +

  # Gray lines connect COL_Low and COL_High
  # values from the same tumor
  geom_line(
    data = paired_pd1_reactome_plot_data_cnv,
    aes(
      group = sample
    ),
    color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # Each point = one tumor-level mean
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = collagen_group
    ),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.035,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Black diamonds = means across paired tumors
  stat_summary(
    data = paired_pd1_reactome_plot_data_cnv,
    aes(
      group = collagen_group
    ),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "COL_Low" = "steelblue",
      "COL_High" = "firebrick"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      pd1_reactome_y_min_cnv,
      pd1_reactome_y_max_cnv
    ),

    breaks =
      pd1_reactome_score_breaks_cnv,

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(

    title =
      "Reactome PD-1 co-inhibition score",

    subtitle =
      pd1_reactome_subtitle_cnv,

    x = NULL,

    y =
      "Mean Reactome PD-1 score",

    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "top",

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 14
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )
  )


print(
  p_pd1_reactome_score_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 17. Create pathway-gene coverage table
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_gene_coverage_cnv <- tibble::tibble(

  Gene =
    pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv

) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    present_in_dataset =
      Gene %in%
        available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv,

    zero_variance =
      Gene %in%
        zero_variance_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv,

    used_in_score =
      Gene %in%
        pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv
  )


# ============================================================
# 18. Save plot
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "PD1_ReactomeScore_CNVFiltered_",
      "COLLow_vs_COLHigh_Paired.pdf"
    )
  ),

  plot =
    p_pd1_reactome_score_cnv,

  device =
    cairo_pdf,

  width = 4,

  height = 4.5,

  units = "in"
)


# ============================================================
# 19. Save underlying values and statistics
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  pd1_reactome_sample_summary_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    "PD1_ReactomeScore_SampleLevel_Values.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  pd1_reactome_score_pairs_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    "PD1_ReactomeScore_Paired_Values.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  pd1_reactome_score_statistics_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    "PD1_ReactomeScore_Paired_Statistics.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  pd1_reactome_gene_coverage_cnv,
  file = file.path(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    "PD1_ReactomeScore_Gene_Coverage.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  tibble::tibble(
    Gene =
      pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv
  ),
  file = file.path(
    pd1_reactome_out_dir,
    "PD1_ReactomeScore_Genes_Used.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 20. Final results to inspect
# ============================================================

pd1_reactome_score_statistics_cnv

pd1_key_gene_check_cnv

cat(
  "\nRequested pathway genes:",
  length(
    pd1_reactome_genes_requested_cnv
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Available pathway genes:",
  length(
    available_pd1_reactome_genes_cnv
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Genes used in score:",
  length(
    pd1_reactome_score_genes_used_cnv
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Paired tumors:",
  n_paired_pd1_reactome_cnv,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Paired Wilcoxon p-value:",
  pd1_reactome_p_value_cnv,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# CNV-filtered PD-1 pathway blocked heatmap
#
# Left block:  COL_Low CT/IT regions
# Right block: COL_High CT/IT regions
#
# Each tile = mean gene expression within one tumor and
# collagen category.
#
# Color = gene-wise z-score of tumor-level mean expression.
# Gray = that tumor had no dots in that collagen category.
#
# This heatmap focuses on biologically interpretable core
# components of the PD-1 inhibitory signaling axis rather than
# every gene in the broad Reactome pathway.
# ============================================================


pd1_heatmap_out_dir <-
  "/Data/Outputs/Manuscript/UCSC/CNV_Filtered/PD1_Reactome_Score/Heatmaps"

if (!dir.exists(pd1_heatmap_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    pd1_heatmap_out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. Define core PD-1 pathway genes
#
# Groups:
#   Receptor / ligands
#   SHP phosphatases
#   TCR signaling machinery
#   PD-L1 regulatory signaling
# ============================================================

pd1_heatmap_gene_sets_cnv <- list(

  `PD-1 axis` = c(
    "PDCD1",
    "CD274",
    "PDCD1LG2"
  ),

  `SHP phosphatases` = c(
    "PTPN6",
    "PTPN11"
  ),

  `TCR signaling` = c(
    "CD247",
    "CD3D",
    "CD3E",
    "CD3G",
    "LCK",
    "CSK"
  ),

  `PD-L1 regulation` = c(
    "JAK1",
    "STAT1",
    "STAT3",
    "IRF1"
  )
)


# Ordered vector
genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv <- unique(
  unlist(
    pd1_heatmap_gene_sets_cnv,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Check gene availability
# ============================================================

missing_pd1_heatmap_genes_cnv <- setdiff(
  genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv,
  colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
)


if (length(missing_pd1_heatmap_genes_cnv) > 0) {

  message(
    "Missing PD-1 heatmap genes omitted: ",
    paste(
      missing_pd1_heatmap_genes_cnv,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv <-
  genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv[
    genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv %in%
      colnames(gene_expr_gbm_cnv)
  ]


stopifnot(
  length(genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv) > 0
)


cat(
  "PD-1 heatmap genes used:",
  length(genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv),
  "\n"
)

print(
  genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Create gene-category annotation
# ============================================================

pd1_heatmap_gene_annotation_cnv <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(pd1_heatmap_gene_sets_cnv),
    function(category_i) {

      tibble::tibble(
        Gene = pd1_heatmap_gene_sets_cnv[[category_i]],
        Category = category_i
      )
    }
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Gene %in% genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Gene,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


pd1_heatmap_gene_annotation_cnv


# ============================================================
# 4. Convert expression to long format
#
# CT and IT dots only.
# Zero-expression dots remain included.
# ============================================================

gene_expression_long_pd1_cnv <-
  gene_expr_gbm_cnv %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    AF_CNV %in% c(
      "CT",
      "IT"
    ),

    collagen_group %in% c(
      "COL_Low",
      "COL_High"
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::select(
    barcode,
    sample,
    AF_CNV,
    collagen_group,
    collagen_score,
    dplyr::all_of(
      genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
    )
  ) %>%

  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
    ),
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    pd1_heatmap_gene_annotation_cnv,
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels = c(
        "COL_Low",
        "COL_High"
      )
    ),

    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels = genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
    )
  )


stopifnot(
  all(
    gene_expression_long_pd1_cnv$AF_CNV %in%
      c(
        "CT",
        "IT"
      )
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Establish tumor and group order
# ============================================================

sample_order_pd1_heatmap_cnv <- sort(
  unique(
    gene_expression_long_pd1_cnv$sample
  )
)


collagen_group_order_pd1_heatmap_cnv <- c(
  "COL_Low",
  "COL_High"
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Calculate tumor-level mean expression
#
# One value for every:
# Gene × tumor × collagen group
# ============================================================

gene_sample_summary_pd1_cnv <-
  gene_expression_long_pd1_cnv %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene),

    collagen_group = as.character(
      collagen_group
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene,
    Category,
    sample,
    collagen_group
  ) %>%

  dplyr::summarise(

    n_dots = dplyr::n(),

    mean_expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    percent_detected = 100 * mean(
      Expression > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Add missing tumor / collagen-group combinations
#
# Missing category:
#   n_dots = 0
#   expression = NA
# ============================================================

gene_sample_summary_pd1_cnv_complete <-
  gene_sample_summary_pd1_cnv %>%

  tidyr::complete(

    tidyr::nesting(
      Gene,
      Category
    ),

    sample =
      sample_order_pd1_heatmap_cnv,

    collagen_group =
      collagen_group_order_pd1_heatmap_cnv,

    fill = list(
      n_dots = 0,
      mean_expression = NA_real_,
      percent_detected = NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. Calculate gene-wise z-scores
#
# Z-score is calculated across tumor-level means from BOTH
# collagen categories.
#
# This allows comparison of relative expression patterns
# between tumors and collagen groups for each gene.
# ============================================================

gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv <-
  gene_sample_summary_pd1_cnv_complete %>%

  dplyr::group_by(
    Gene
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    gene_mean = mean(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    gene_sd = stats::sd(
      mean_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_expression_z = dplyr::case_when(

      is.na(mean_expression) ~
        NA_real_,

      !is.finite(gene_mean) ~
        0,

      is.na(gene_sd) ~
        0,

      gene_sd == 0 ~
        0,

      TRUE ~
        (
          mean_expression -
            gene_mean
        ) /
        gene_sd
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::ungroup()


# ============================================================
# 9. Set factor order
#
# Reverse gene order so PDCD1 is displayed at the top.
# ============================================================

pd1_gene_order_for_plot_cnv <- rev(
  genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
)


gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv <-
  gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels =
        sample_order_pd1_heatmap_cnv
    ),

    collagen_group = factor(
      collagen_group,
      levels =
        collagen_group_order_pd1_heatmap_cnv
    ),

    Gene = factor(
      Gene,
      levels =
        pd1_gene_order_for_plot_cnv
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. Create blocked PD-1 pathway heatmap
# ============================================================

p_gene_heatmap_pd1_cnv <- ggplot(
  gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv,
  aes(
    x = sample,
    y = Gene,
    fill = mean_expression_z
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(
      collagen_group
    ),
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "steelblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,

    limits = c(
      -2,
      2
    ),

    oob = scales::squish,

    na.value = "grey75",

    name = paste0(
      "Mean expression\n",
      "z-score"
    )
  ) +

  labs(

    title =
      "PD-1 pathway expression in CNV-filtered GBM regions",

    subtitle = paste0(
      "CT and IT dots only; tumor-level mean expression; ",
      "gray indicates no dots in that collagen category"
    ),

    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(

    axis.line =
      element_blank(),

    axis.ticks =
      element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 9
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey92",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.35,
      "cm"
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9
    )
  )


print(
  p_gene_heatmap_pd1_cnv
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Save heatmap
# ============================================================

pd1_heatmap_height_cnv <- max(
  5,
  0.32 *
    length(
      genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv
    ) +
    2
)


ggsave(

  filename = file.path(
    pd1_heatmap_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "PD1_CorePathway_CNVFiltered_",
      "COLLow_COLHigh_Heatmap.pdf"
    )
  ),

  plot =
    p_gene_heatmap_pd1_cnv,

  device =
    cairo_pdf,

  width = 9,

  height =
    pd1_heatmap_height_cnv,

  units = "in"
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Save underlying heatmap data
# ============================================================

write.csv(

  gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv,

  file = file.path(
    pd1_heatmap_out_dir,
    paste0(
      "PD1_CorePathway_CNVFiltered_",
      "Heatmap_Data.csv"
    )
  ),

  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(

  pd1_heatmap_gene_annotation_cnv,

  file = file.path(
    pd1_heatmap_out_dir,
    "PD1_CorePathway_Gene_Categories.csv"
  ),

  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Inspect final results
# ============================================================

dim(
  gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv
)


genes_to_plot_pd1_cnv


missing_pd1_heatmap_genes_cnv


gene_sample_heatmap_pd1_cnv %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene,
    sample,
    collagen_group,
    mean_expression,
    mean_expression_z,
    percent_detected
  ) %>%
  print(
    n = 30
  )
```
